units.text: How macOS Adapts Its Controls for Touch on the New MacBook Pro

Apple announced a new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display on Wednesday. It's Apple's first Mac with a screen that supports touch, and demonstrations Apple gave to the media show how macOS reshapes its controls for finger input. Menu bar items expand under a fingertip, window controls get bigger, and the Dynamic Island pulls down into a floating widget, amongst other changes.

Back in 2016, then-senior VP of marketing Phil Schiller (now Apple Fellow) argued that putting touch on a Mac display would mean "totally redesigning the menu bar for fingers" – something he said would clash with pointer devices. Apple's modern solution, however, is more subtle. The menu bar looks the same, but when you move a finger over a menu item, it expands to let you make a selection with more precision.

The same idea applies elsewhere in the macOS interface. For example, the traffic-light buttons that control window size and position also get bigger when you touch them, after which you make your selection with a tap. You can also swipe up from the bottom of the screen to reveal a hidden Dock.
A Pull-Down Dynamic Island

Elsewhere, the new MacBook Pro replaces the notch with a Dynamic Island where Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI live. You can pull down on the Dynamic Island to open an expanded version that floats on the screen like a widget, giving you access to Siri responses and Spotlight search.

Apple says macOS automatically translates touch into clicks, so many existing apps will work with touch right away – no developer updates required. Possible interactions include swiping to scroll a webpage, pinching to zoom in on a photo, dragging and dropping slides between presentations, and double-tapping a window to fill the screen.

The foundation has been visible in macOS for months. macOS Golden Gate added iPhone-style pull-to-refresh gestures in apps like Safari, Mail, and Calendar, while code in macOS 27.2 added touch-specific gesture recognition in Safari, Notes, Photos, and Quick Look.
Precision Work in Pro Apps

It appears that touch isn't just for casual swipes either. Pro application features have also been updated to work with fingers, such as color grading in DaVinci Resolve and tweaking soundtracks in Logic Pro.

How well the interactions hold up in daily use is something we'll only be able to judge when the new MacBook Pro arrives in customers' hands. The machines are available to pre-order now, starting at $2,899 for the 14-inch model and $3,399 for the 16-inch model. They officially launch on Friday, November 6.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，据 X 平台博主 Federico Viticci 今日分享的现场体验，苹果新款 MacBook Pro（配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏）可以关闭触控功能。
博主表示，用户可在系统设置的“辅助功能”中关掉触控，此后屏幕将不再响应手指触控，但键盘和触控板依然可用。除此之外苹果还带来了新版缩放功能，用户可通过捏合手势放大界面的部分区域。
IT之家注意到，新款 MacBook Pro 在系统设置中新增了触控屏幕栏目，用户可在此配置页面切换、调度中心、Exposé、通知中心、现实桌面的手势。上述操作的具体手势基本上和触控板相同，用户可分别开启或关闭。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 本月 23 日正式上市后，有消费者反映手机内屏存在沿折叠区域开裂、出现亮线等问题。
据新华社今日报道，苹果公司在向新华社记者提供的声明中承认少量设备存在内屏问题，但未公布故障原因及受影响设备数量。
彭博社及多家科技媒体报道提到，一些消费者在展开手机时感到铰链阻力异常或听到碎裂声，随后内屏中央折叠区域出现裂纹，部分设备伴有亮线、白斑等显示异常。相关投诉涉及美国、澳大利亚、印度等市场，加拿大和中国也出现相关报告。但目前尚无完整的全球故障统计。
彭博社报道，已独立核实多名消费者的相关投诉，这些消费者提供了设备损坏照片或与苹果公司售后沟通的记录。其中，美国得克萨斯州一名消费者表示，购机约 30 小时后内屏出现裂纹。印度金奈一名消费者称，展开手机时感觉铰链异常紧涩，随后屏幕出现损坏。
澳大利亚一名消费者在社交平台表示，手机使用约 6 小时、展开不到 20 次后，内屏沿铰链位置开裂，随后在苹果零售店获得换机。
美国科技媒体“苹果内幕”网站联系了美国 20 家苹果零售店技术支持部门，了解到 4 起 iPhone Duo 内屏故障案例，相关设备均已更换。该网站同时指出，其不掌握这些门店以外及苹果线上售后渠道的数据，相关数字不能反映全球故障规模。
电子产品拆解机构艾菲克西特公司在 25 日发布的报告中提出，问题可能与折叠铰链内部的机械结构有关。该机构分析认为，手机折叠时，铰链中央支撑杆未能充分下移避开屏幕，导致弯曲的屏幕压在支撑杆上，形成局部应力集中。不过，这仍是技术推测，尚未得到苹果确认。
截至 28 日，苹果尚未披露全球受影响设备总量及故障率，也未公布故障的具体原因，以及是否需要调整产品设计或制造工艺。
另据IT之家 10 月 27 日报道，苹果公司在给 MacRumors 的一份声明中回应了内屏故障问题，称如果遇到相关故障，可以联系苹果官方客服 AppleCare 申请更换。

这是苹果首次为Mac引入触控屏，同时将iPhone标志性的灵动岛设计带到Mac平台，经典的A面发光苹果Logo也正式回归。
据了解，新款MacBook Pro提供14英寸和16英寸两种尺寸，均搭载全新的ProLED XDR显示屏，提供M5 Pro和M5 Max两款芯片可选。
新机最高可选配128GB统一内存和16TB固态硬盘，能够满足专业视频剪辑、3D渲染以及本地AI模型运行等高负载需求。
屏幕是此次MacBook Pro的一大升级，首次采用双层串联OLED技术，通过两层自发光像素结构，实现更高的亮度、对比度和显示均匀性。

值得一提的是，新款MacBook Pro还用灵动岛取代了此前的刘海屏设计，可用于显示实时活动、通知以及音乐播放等信息，并支持直接触控交互。

同时，配备1200万像素Center Stage摄像头、录音棚级麦克风以及六扬声器音响系统。

units.text: There weren’t too many surprises with yesterday’s launch of the first touchscreen Mac, the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display. But one of those was the option to spec the SSD to a massive 16TB.
With the M6 MacBook Pro the new entry-level model, that means that you can now spend anywhere between $1,999 and $14,549 on a new MacBook Pro …
The cheapest MacBook Pro in the new lineup is the 14-inch M6 model with the standard spec:
14-inch screen
M6 chip (12-core CPU, 12-core GPU)
16GB unified memory
1TB SSD
That option is yours for $1,999.
The most expensive model is a maxed-out 16-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display:
16-inch screen with nano-texture glass
M5 Max chip with option 2 (18-core CPU, 40-core GPU)
128GB unified memory
16TB SSD
Yours for a mere $14,549.
For anyone trying to justify this, you can console yourself that you’ll be paying half the price of a maxed-out Mac Studio, after the 512GB option became available:
M5 Ultra chip with option 2 (36-core CPU, 80-core GPU)
512GB unified memory
16TB SSD
As we noted yesterday, that will run you $29,799.

units.text: Apple’s new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display (pre-order here) includes a variety of software optimizations for touch input. But Apple says it’s “only getting started” making macOS more touch-friendly.
Apple plans to continue refining touch experience in macOS
The new touchscreen-equipped MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR will ship with macOS 27.2, software that includes a variety of touch-centric optimizations that only impact PROLED XDR users.
Early feedback from hands-on testers, including our own Chance Miller, appears very positive.

Bloomberg’s Chris Welch reassuringly says that Apple is “taking a measured approach as it introduces touch capabilities.” This echoes comments from John Gruber, who says his concerns about touch “adversely affecting the Mac UI” have all been allayed.
But it sounds like Apple plans to roll out even more macOS optimizations for touch in the future.
Chris Welch writes at Bloomberg:

An Apple employee answering press questions at Wednesday’s event said the company is only getting started optimizing macOS for a touch screen. I’d expect a slew of refinements to arrive alongside macOS 28 next year, much in the way the iPhone Duo’s user experience will inevitably evolve with iOS 28.
Overall, this isn’t necessarily reason for alarm if you’re worried about touch having a negative impact on macOS.
View all comments

Even though Apple has prepared an initial set of macOS changes to support touch input, it’s only natural for the company to continue refining the touch experience in response to early adopter feedback and usage patterns. My assumption is that the same “measured approach” we’re seeing right now will continue guiding these future macOS enhancements.
You can pre-order MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR on Amazon for day-one delivery.
What do you think of Apple’s efforts at adding touch to macOS? Let us know in the comments.
*Buy Mac with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

units.text: A new report from TrendForce explores Apple’s impact on the OLED notebook market following the launch of its first touchscreen MacBook Pro, and the company’s own shipment prospects for 2027. Here are the details.
OLED suppliers compete for MacBook Air contracts
Apple yesterday announced the new touchscreen MacBook Pro, which features the same tandem OLED technology it first introduced with the M4 iPad Pro in 2024.

With two OLED layers stacked on top of each other, the technology delivers higher brightness than conventional single-layer OLED displays, while maintaining the deep blacks, high contrast ratios, and power efficiency that OLED is known for.
And while yesterday’s announcement made it official, Apple’s first touchscreen Mac has long been rumored through leaks, reports, and supply chain analyses.

In September 2025, for instance, The Elec reported that Samsung Display was preparing to begin mass production of 14-inch and 16-inch OLED panels for Apple’s MacBook Pro in the second quarter of 2026, with an estimated annual output of 2–3 million units.
Two months later, TrendForce predicted that OLED notebook market share would reach up to 12% between 2027 and 2028, partly driven by Apple’s expected adoption of the technology.

Then, earlier this year, TrendForce published an OLED roadmap predicting that Apple would introduce OLED displays to the MacBook Pro lineup in 2026, followed by the MacBook Air in 2029 (pushed back from 2027).
Now, TrendForce has published a new report with new shipment forecasts for Apple’s OLED MacBook Pro and the broader OLED notebook market.

According to the firm, Apple is expected to ship between 1.2 million and 1.5 million units of the new MacBook Pro in 2027. Meanwhile, global OLED notebook shipments are projected to “grow nearly 40% YoY in 2026, followed by another increase of more than 40% in 2027.”
From the report:

Until now, the OLED notebook market has been driven primarily by Windows-based brands such as Lenovo, HP, and ASUS, which have gradually expanded their OLED offerings across different price segments. Apple’s arrival is expected to give the market additional momentum, encouraging brands to prioritize OLED models in their product roadmaps while strengthening consumer acceptance of the technology. This, in turn, could pave the way for broader OLED adoption in notebook displays.

TrendForce also notes that the “new MacBook Pro’s premium starting price of US$2,899 for the 14-inch model, coupled with its initial availability alongside existing Mini-LED models, could temper near-term replacement demand.”

As for Apple’s first OLED MacBook Air, now expected to debut in 2029, TrendForce says LG Display, BOE, and TCL CSOT are currently competing to become display suppliers for the upcoming model, as the companies continue developing their OLED manufacturing capabilities.
Finally, TrendForce projects that global OLED notebook shipments will reach 46.6 million units by 2030, though year-over-year growth will slow to 30.8%, following a peak of 42.8% in 2028.
To read TrendForce’s full report, follow this link.

units.text: 据《连线》杂志报道，苹果周三发布了新款MacBook Pro，这款笔记本的一个重大卖点就是触摸屏。此前，苹果一直抵制给Mac上添加触摸屏，这次为何态度突然转变呢？
特努斯
苹果CEO约翰·特努斯(John Ternus)、硬件负责人约翰尼·斯鲁吉(Johny Srouji)和营销负责人格雷格·“乔兹”·乔斯维亚克(Greg “Joz” Joswiak)接受了《连线》的采访，谈到了公司决定为Mac引入触摸屏的原因。
对于苹果打破长期禁忌，推出一款配备触摸屏的Macintosh电脑，特努斯笑容满面地说：“谁能想到呢？”
特努斯在采访中指出，尽管通过触控板和键盘进行间接输入仍然是Mac体验的核心，但“有时候，触控操作会更舒适、更方便”。
他强调，苹果将触控功能视为一项附加功能，而不是一项需要以牺牲MacBook Pro设计为代价才能实现的功能。
“我们需要确保，加入触控功能不会以任何方式降低产品的品质。它不会因此变得更重，也不会变得更厚。这一点与OLED屏幕一起实现了，那是我们装进Mac里的最好的显示屏。所有这些优势集于一身。而且，没错，它还支持触控。”特努斯称。
斯鲁吉表示，过去十年间的技术进步，终于让苹果能够在推出触摸屏Mac的同时，满足自身的高标准。“十年是一段非常、非常漫长的时间，”斯鲁吉说，“很多事情都发生了变化，无论是显示技术、定制芯片，还是其他方面。最终，芯片、显示技术和软件架构的融合达到了我们的标准。我希望我的工程师受到物理定律的限制，而不是受想象力或时间表的束缚。”
乔斯维亚克则指出，苹果做出这一决定，部分原因在于新一代用户已经习惯了以触控为主的交互方式，他们希望能够直接触摸屏幕进行操作。
“多数专业用户都拥有iPad，几乎所有专业用户都拥有iPhone，”乔斯维亚克说，“因此，他们对触摸操作已经驾轻就熟。现在有一代年轻的创作者和年轻用户正在使用我们的MacBook Pro，他们期待能够直接触摸屏幕进行操作。”

units.text: 苹果最新发布的 M6 版 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 最高内存带宽为 170GB/s，不过这个内存带宽仅限于 24GB 和 32GB 内存版，基础款配置也就是 16GB 内存的带宽为 153GB/s，与 M5 版 MacBook Pro 相同。
根据苹果公布的技术规格，16GB 版内存带宽为 153GB/s，24GB 和 32GB 版内存带宽均为 170GB/s。内存带宽可以理解为处理器与内存间传输数据的速度上限，更高的内存带宽有助于提高部分场景的性能。
苹果的统一内存由 CPU、GPU 和神经网络引擎等组件共享，因此带宽可能影响需要频繁读取大量数据的任务，例如处理大型图像和视频、运行本地 AI 模型或执行图形计算。不过实际体验还取决于应用是否受到内存带宽限制、所需的内存容量。
M6 芯片只是基础款因此配备的内存带宽也不算太高，像是 M5 Pro 版 MacBook Pro 内存带宽达到 307GB/s，而 M5 Max 则根据配置提供 460GB/s 或 614GB/s 的内存带宽，这些机型面向更高性能需求，芯片和整机价格也更高。
对用户而言主要需要考虑自己的使用场景，如果频繁运行本地 AI 模型那确实需要更大的内存和更高的内存带宽，日常办公和处理简单任务的话，整体来说性能要求不是非常高，即便使用 M6 16GB 内存也是够用的，当然如果资金充足最好还是继续加内存，避免以后要使用但内存捉襟见肘。

units.text: The iPhone Duo has in customers' hands for a week, and developers have produced some truly impressive apps and games that make the most of Apple's first foldable display. Here are 10 that we like.

Developers have been hard at work updating existing apps and building new ones ever since Apple announced the iPhone Duo on September 9, 2026. And this being a brand-new device, they had plenty of work to do just to make old apps look their best both on the internal 7.6-inch display and the outer 5.4-inch screen.

Thankfully, this isn't the App Store's first rodeo, and developers have risen to the occasion before. The arrival of the iPad in 2010 meant building whole new versions of existing apps. The Apple Watch changed things again in 2015.

In 2026, the iPhone Duo provides new ways for apps to display information beyond the extra display. Holding and folding the iPhone Duo in different ways and positions opens the door to new ways to use apps, too.

Here, we've built a list of the 10 apps and games that really show off what the iPhone Duo can do. Whether you've been using your iPhone Duo for a week, or you're still waiting for yours to arrive, this is the list that you've been waiting for.
Netflix
Netflix reacts to the way you use your iPhone Duo - Image: Netflix

Netflix might not be the first company that you think of when looking for great examples of iPhone Duo apps, but it should be. After ignoring the Apple Vision Pro, Netflix has been much more keen on putting its best foot forward for iPhone Duo.

The newly updated Netflix app dynamically adapts to which display you're using, and in which orientation. Whether you watch in full-screen mode, using the book or tent poses, or a tabletop view, Netflix reacts accordingly.

Part of that reaction is to put media playback controls on the lower part of the display when using the tabletop pose. Propping the iPhone Duo up in tent mode gives you a full-screen landscape view without needing a stand. The app even reacts to the angle of the hinge, too.
Netflix is a free download with a subscription required to watch content.
Flighty
Flighty is the perfect flight tracking app for iPhone Duo - Image: Flighty
Flighty has long been a favorite among many iPhone owners who want lightning-fast airplane and airport data when traveling. With iPhone Duo, the app has been refreshed accordingly.
When opened, the iPhone Duo's display offers a full-sized map alongside full flight data, side-by-side. This approach gives you a more detailed view than any other iPhone can manage.
In tent mode, Flighty uses the landscape outer display to provide flight details hands-free, perfect for placing on a tray table.
Flighty is a free download with optional in-app purchases.
Deck-Man
Turn your iPhone Duo into a classic cassette player - Image: Squircle Apps

Deck-Man is a return to the days of the early App Store, when apps like iBeer brought the whimsy to iPhones everywhere. The app turns your iPhone Duo into a retro cassette player that uses your Apple Music library.

With Deck-Man, you can choose an album and insert the tape, then close the iPhone Duo to start playback. You'll hear all of the mechanical movements and clicks that owners of old Walkman players will remember, too.
Deck-Man costs $4.99 and is available in the App Store now.
MD Vinyl
Combine record playing with digital music - Image: MD Studio
Similar to Deck-Man, MD Vinyl brings a touch of nostalgia to your music in a whole new way. The app combines the ritual of listening to a vinyl record with the convenience of digital music.

When used on an iPhone Duo, MD Vinyl can be used in desktop mode with the record spinning on the bottom of the display and album art shown above. Tent mode props the iPhone Duo up and uses the outer display to show your music's album art alongside a spinning record.
With the iPhone Duo open, MD Vinyl uses the inner display to show album artwork alongside a playlist for easier navigation.
MD Vinyl is a free download with optional in-app purchases.
Toastie
Turn iPhone Duo into a sandwich maker - Image: Toastie

Toastie is the first game on our list, and it brings to mind the kind of games that made smart use of the Nintendo DS's foldable form factor over 20 years ago. In this case, gamers are tasked with building a sandwich to specification as quickly as possible.
Toastie is played on the iPhone Duo's inner, foldable display and looks gorgeous. Where the fun comes in is when it's time to turn the sandwich into a toastie.

With the sandwich complete, gamers close the iPhone Duo to "toast" the sandwich before reopening it to reveal the finished article. It's great fun, just don't try to make a real toastie with your $2,000 iPhone Duo.
Toastie costs $2.99 and is available in the App Store now.
Delta
Delta 2.0 turns an iPhone Duo into a Nintendo DS - Images: Testut Tech
We've long been fans of Delta, a retro game emulator for the iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Now, we're even bigger fans of its iPhone Duo update.
Many Delta fans have used the app to emulate Nintendo DS games, and it's great at it. But the Nintendo DS is a foldable device with two displays, so it isn't at its best on a normal iPhone.
On an iPhone Duo, however, everything changes. The new Delta update turns a half-folded iPhone Duo into an actual Nintendo DS, faithfully replicating its interface and dual displays.

Just like the real thing, closing an iPhone Duo with Delta running also puts the emulated Nintendo DS into sleep mode. We're not saying you should buy a foldable iPhone just to play Nintendo DS games, but it wouldn't be the worst idea in the world.
Detla is a free download with an optional in-app purchase.
Tiny Computers
Subscribe to AppleInsider on YouTube

Tiny Computers turns your iPhone Duo into a range of devices inspired by decades of iconic machines. In tabletop mode, an iPhone Duo can become everything from a classic Commodore 64 to Apple's own iconic Macintosh.
Laptops look particularly great on an iPhone Duo in tabletop mode. By using the familiar laptop form factor, the iPhone sports interactive keyboards that even click as you type.

Tiny Computers doesn't just make your iPhone Duo look like a classic machine; it makes it work like one, too. You can use apps, open windows, even draw and write notes for the perfect waltz down memory lane.
Tiny Computers costs $3.99 and is available now.
PianoFold
PianoFold is a rhythm game for iPhone Duo - Image: Vision First Studio

Fans of Guitar Hero and Rock Band will know what to do as soon as PianoFold appears on an iPhone Duo's foldable display. Set the iPhone Duo up in tabletop mode, and colorful tiles slide from the top half of the display towards color-matched buttons on the bottom.

From here, your fingers will take over. They'll tap the pads as the colored tiles fall to meet them in a familiar rhythm game pattern. But the iPhone Duo takes things a step further by turning your room into the stage.
Via the iPhone Duo's camera, PianoFold uses your room as the background for the game itself. The game features 40 pieces of music for you to play along to, from Beethoven to Joplin and beyond.
PianoFold is a free download with an in-app purchase required to unlock the full game.
Fineliner
Fineliner makes full use of Apple Pencil support - Images: Marco Arment
Fineliner is a notebook app for iPhone and iPad, but it's at its best when used on an iPhone Duo. You'll also want to use an Apple Pencil (USB-C) to get the most out of it, too.

At first blush, Fineliner is another note-taking app. But things change when you're asked to draw the elements that will ultimately become the app's on-screen interface. You can even hand-draw the font, too.

You can type into Fineliner, but Apple Pencil support means it's quicker and easier to write directly on the screen instead. That also turns the iPhone Duo into the closest thing to a real notebook we've seen yet.
A great combination of whimsical app design and really useful features, Fineliner is worth a place on all iPhone Duo Home Screens.
Fineliner is a free download with optional in-app purchases.
DexFold
iPhone Duo will surely help fans catch 'em all - Image: IntraPixel

Made specifically for foldable devices, DexFold turns the iPhone Duo into a Pokedex with support for over 1,000 Pokemon. Fold the iPhone Duo slightly, and you'll be shown a screen full of data, including stats, moves, and evolutions.

When open, the iPhone Duo looks and behaves like a real book-like Pokedex. Close the iPhone Duo, and you'll see what appears to be a closed book. You can even use the iPhone's camera to scan Pokemon to be added to DexFold.
DexFold is a free download with an optional in-app purchase.

evidence.title: TrendForce 预测：全球 OLED 笔电出货量有望在中期维持超 30% 年增幅
evidence.raw_lead: 机构认为 MacBook Pro (PROLED XDR 显示屏) 在 2027 年有望出货 120~150 万台。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，苹果北京时间今日发布了 MacBook Pro (PROLED XDR 显示屏)。在首款 OLED MacBook 产品面世后，研调机构 TrendForce（集邦）发布了对整体 OLED 笔电市场的最新预测。
机构认为，配备 OLED 屏幕的笔记本电脑整机出货量在 2026~2030 年期间维持超 30% 的同比增幅，其中 2027~2029 年增长都将超过 40%；出货总量将从今年的 1260 万台增长至期末的 4660 万台。
▲ 图源：TrendForce
针对 OLED MacBook Pro，机构的看法是其短期内需求动能将受到高价定位与产品重叠的限制，但长远来看有助于进一步巩固苹果高端产品的技术形象与溢价定位。该机型 2027 年预计可出货 120~150 万台。
OLED MacBook Pro 的面世也有望促使其它品牌优先规划 OLED 机型、提高消费者对 OLED 笔电的接受度。而在显示面板制造商方面，除拿下新品独供地位的三星显示外，其它业者则瞄准预计 2029 年发布的 OLED MacBook Air。
参考

units.text: 根据市场研究机构TrendForce的最新预测，尽管全球笔记本电脑市场整体面临增长压力，OLED笔记本电脑市场仍将保持强劲增长势头。预计2026年全球OLED笔记本电脑出货量将同比增长近40%，2027年进一步增长超过40%。苹果推出采用全新OLED显示技术的MacBook Pro，被认为将成为推动行业发展的重要因素，同时也促使显示面板制造商加快相关技术研发与产能布局。
苹果新款MacBook Pro搭载名为PROLED XDR的显示屏，成为MacBook产品线中首款采用串联式OLED触控屏的机型。这一变化标志着苹果笔记本电脑显示技术的重要转折，也有望推动高端笔记本电脑市场加快向OLED技术转型。TrendForce预计，该款新机2027年的出货量将达到120万至150万台。
不过，新款MacBook Pro的市场表现仍存在一定的不确定性。14英寸机型起售价高达2899美元，加上新款产品初期将与现有Mini-LED版本并行销售，可能限制消费者短期内的换机需求。尽管如此，此次产品更新进一步强化了苹果在高端市场的定位，也体现出其试图通过不同价格区间的产品布局扩大市场覆盖面的战略。
在苹果进入这一市场之前，全球OLED笔记本电脑市场主要由联想、惠普和华硕等采用Windows系统的品牌推动。这些厂商近年来逐步将OLED显示屏引入不同价位的产品系列，使该技术不再局限于少数高端机型。苹果的加入预计将进一步提升市场对OLED笔记本电脑的关注度，促使更多品牌在未来产品规划中优先考虑OLED方案，并增强消费者对这一显示技术的接受程度。
OLED技术在画面表现、机身设计和显示性能方面具有一定优势。与传统液晶显示屏相比，OLED能够实现更高的对比度、更深的黑色表现以及更快的像素响应速度，同时有利于打造更轻薄的笔记本电脑。不过，面板制造成本、生产良率以及不同产品对亮度和使用寿命的要求，仍然是影响其进一步普及的重要因素。
TrendForce指出，尽管全球笔记本电脑市场整体预计将连续两年出现收缩，OLED笔记本电脑出货量却有望逆势增长。苹果的产品转型不仅会增加OLED面板需求，也将推动整个产业链加快技术升级，尤其是在高分辨率、低功耗和高亮度等方面的研发投入。
在供应链方面，三星显示目前是这款新型MacBook Pro的独家OLED面板供应商。该公司已将位于韩国牙山园区的第六代以上大尺寸OLED生产线A6项目第一阶段指定为苹果专用生产设施。
这款MacBook Pro对三星显示具有重要的战略意义，因为它是该公司G8.6代精细金属掩模（FMM）OLED生产线上首款进入量产阶段的产品。苹果选择三星显示为其首款高端OLED笔记本电脑供应面板，不仅体现了三星在先进显示技术领域的实力，也进一步巩固了其在高端OLED面板市场的竞争地位。
新款MacBook Pro采用串联式OLED结构，像素密度达到每英寸254像素，对面板制造提出了相当高的要求。串联式OLED通过叠加多个发光层，有望在亮度、能效和面板使用寿命之间取得更好的平衡，但制造工艺也更加复杂，对材料成本、生产良率和工艺控制提出了更高要求。
目前，其他面板厂商也在开展相关产品的资格认证工作，但苹果严格的技术规格，加上三星显示已经建立的供应优势，使竞争对手进入这一供应链面临较高门槛。因此，LG显示、京东方和TCL华星等厂商，正将更多精力放在争取未来OLED版MacBook Air的面板订单上。该产品预计将于2029年推出。
随着苹果逐步扩大OLED在笔记本电脑产品线中的应用，显示面板供应商之间的竞争预计将进一步加剧。未来，能够在生产成本、制造良率、显示性能和大规模供货能力之间取得平衡的厂商，将更有机会获得主要笔记本电脑品牌的订单。虽然OLED短期内仍难以全面取代液晶显示屏，但随着产能扩大和技术持续成熟，其在笔记本电脑市场的渗透率有望进一步提高。

不过，新款MacBook Pro的市场表现仍存在一定的不确定性。14英寸机型起售价高达2899美元，加上新款产品初期将与现有Mini-LED版本并行销售，可能限制消费者短期内的换机需求。尽管如此，此次产品更新进一步强化了苹果在高端市场的定位，也体现出其试图通过不同价格区间的产品布局扩大市场覆盖面的战略。
在供应链方面，三星显示目前是这款新型MacBook Pro的独家OLED面板供应商。该公司已将位于韩国牙山园区的第六代以上大尺寸OLED生产线A6项目第一阶段指定为苹果专用生产设施。
这款MacBook Pro对三星显示具有重要的战略意义，因为它是该公司G8.6代精细金属掩模（FMM）OLED生产线上首款进入量产阶段的产品。苹果选择三星显示为其首款高端OLED笔记本电脑供应面板，不仅体现了三星在先进显示技术领域的实力，也进一步巩固了其在高端OLED面板市场的竞争地位。
新款MacBook Pro采用串联式OLED结构，像素密度达到每英寸254像素，对面板制造提出了相当高的要求。串联式OLED通过叠加多个发光层，有望在亮度、能效和面板使用寿命之间取得更好的平衡，但制造工艺也更加复杂，对材料成本、生产良率和工艺控制提出了更高要求。
目前，其他面板厂商也在开展相关产品的资格认证工作，但苹果严格的技术规格，加上三星显示已经建立的供应优势，使竞争对手进入这一供应链面临较高门槛。因此，LG显示、京东方和TCL华星等厂商，正将更多精力放在争取未来OLED版MacBook Air的面板订单上。该产品预计将于2029年推出。

evidence.title: When to expect your pre-ordered Apple devices to ship

units.text: Apple has launched a slew of new devices, and many of them start shipping on November 6. That date is going to be a good one to go check out an Apple Store, as depending on what you've pre-ordered, there may not be much reason to wait.
As ever, the devil is in the details of what precise configuration you've ordered. But, for instance, adding a nanotexture display to a MacBook Pro or an iPad will add delays.
iPhone Duo

There's actually some good news about iPhone Duo shipping dates, although don't get excited. Where up to very recently an order placed today would see delivery on January 25, 2027, it's currently showing as January 22.
After it's startlingly fast selling out, orders for the iPhone Duo are actually seeing some very small improvement in shipping times - image credit: Apple
That's for either color of the device, but also for the base configuration. All of the dates here are for the base models, except where certain features are only available with specific models.
Mac Studio

For instance, the latest Mac Studio has been out for some months and if you order many of the possible configurations today, they could be right in stock and ready to ship. That's the case with the M5 Max processor.
Apple is taking pre-orders for the 512GB Mac Studio, but you still have months to wait.
For the M5 Ultra edition, shipping is currently in 7 to 8 weeks' time.
Apple did finally announce a new configuration that is an M5 Ultra Mac Studio with 512GB RAM. That's currently due to ship in 10-12 weeks, in January 2027.
MacBook Pro

If you ordered the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 processor when it was announced on October 27, you may have had cause to regret it on October 28 when the touch-screen tandem-OLED display version was launched.
That's especially because both the touch and non-touch 14-inch MacBook Pro are shipping on November 6.

This is still the case if you choose the nanotexture display option on the 14-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED. But it isn't if you go for nanotexture on the display of the 16-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED.
In that case, just selecting the nanotexture option pushes shipping back an entire day. Delivery will be on November 7 instead of November 6.

Things are a little more complicated with the non-touch 14-inch MacBook Pro. Apple does still list most versions as shipping on November 6, but if you order silver with a nanotexture display, Apple is quoting 7-10 business days.
However, if you order the Space Black edition with nanotexture, things are very different. Placing such an order today gets you a quoted delivery date of between three and four weeks.
iMac
At least the iMac is easier. Pre-orders are open now and shipping will be on November 6.
The iMac is the one device you can still configure how you like and get it from the first day possible - image credit: Apple
For now at least, you can pick any configuration of color, storage, and RAM, and there will be no delay.
iPad mini
Back to the complexity and the delays we go. If you order the base 128GB iPad mini, you're fine, it'll arrive on November 6.
The new iPad mini sees delays if you want both a nanotexture display and cellular- image credit: Apple
That's the case whether you go for the Wi-FI-only or Wi-Fi plus Cellular model at 128GB. If you go for 256GB, though, you get the option of a nanotexture display and that can add delays.
Oddly, if you choose nanotexture glass, you still get it on November 6 unless you also specify that you want the cellular model. Then your delivery time is two to three weeks.
HomeView

The HomeView has perhaps been a little drowned out by all of the launches, but it's still had an impact. Originally due to ship on November 13, the table version of HomeView is mostly now back-ordered three to four weeks.
Most colors of the HomeView are now backordered - - image credit: Apple
There is an exception, though, as at time of writing the rose pink version of this model remains due to ship on November 13.

So does the wall-mounted HomeView, though, in either of its colors and all of its available mounting options. Apple is now saying that there's a Schneider Home Power Mount PoE Wired option coming, but it doesn't say when.
Buying in Apple Stores

If we've learned anything from the iPhone Duo's success, it is that it can still be worth going to an Apple Stores on the first day a device is due out. You'll definitely get to see and try one, for example.

It's more likely that you'll be able to buy any of these devices other than the iPhone Duo, too. But it is always the case that Apple Stores tend to stock the versions that will sell the fastest, which usually means the base model.
So if you want to buy a Mac Studio configured with 512GB RAM for an extra $15,500, you'll have to just order online and wait it out.

units.text: 俄罗斯政府进一步强化对数字通信的监管力度。根据最新规定，苹果公司和微软已被纳入俄罗斯国家“信息传播组织者”登记系统，这意味着两家公司未来需在当局提出要求时，向俄罗斯安全部门提供用户的文字、语音和视频通信数据，而无需经过传统司法程序。
报道称，苹果和微软于2026年10月2日被正式列入该登记系统。该系统由俄罗斯联邦通信、信息技术和大众传媒监督局（Roskomnadzor）管理。目前，包括WhatsApp和Telegram在内的多家通信平台此前已经受到同类监管措施约束，因此苹果此次被纳入名单被视为俄罗斯持续加强信息控制政策的最新一步。
根据俄罗斯法律，一旦被列入该登记系统，企业必须保存俄罗斯用户的通信记录最长三年。相关数据需要存储在位于俄罗斯境内的服务器上，并在安全机构要求时向其提供。
截至目前，苹果和微软均未就新要求公开发表评论。报道指出，苹果历来会在全球市场遵守当地法律，但在部分情况下，如果公司不同意相关规定，也会选择调整或关闭某些功能。
例如，英国政府曾在2025年要求获得更广泛的数据访问权限，苹果随后选择仅在英国关闭高级数据保护（Advanced Data Protection）功能，而不是建立所谓的“后门”访问机制。此外，由于与监管政策存在分歧，苹果也未在欧盟地区推出部分新功能和服务。
事实上，俄罗斯近年来持续要求国际科技企业加强本地化运营。2022年，俄罗斯曾因苹果未将iCloud数据存储在本地服务器而对其处以罚款。同年，俄罗斯还通过法律，要求大型国际科技公司在当地设立正式办公机构。
作为回应，苹果于2022年2月在莫斯科设立了企业办公室。不过，苹果从未在俄罗斯开设官方Apple Store零售店。2022年俄乌冲突爆发后，苹果暂停了俄罗斯境内在线销售业务。
尽管如此，多年来苹果设备仍通过第三方经销商在俄罗斯市场销售，苹果多项数字服务也一直向俄罗斯用户开放，直到2026年初才陆续停止部分服务和应用订阅业务。
报道指出，苹果之所以长期维持部分服务运行，部分原因在于App Store等数字服务处于法律认定较为复杂的灰色地带。例如，俄罗斯用户订阅本土应用理论上属于用户与开发者之间的交易，但苹果作为应用商店运营方仍会从中收取分成收入。
2026年3月，苹果主动向监管机构报告了相关合规问题。由于美国以外地区业务由苹果爱尔兰公司负责，因此由该实体向英国监管部门进行了申报。随后，英国方面认定苹果在“较大概率上”违反了针对俄罗斯的制裁规定，并对其处以罚款。此后，苹果停止继续提供相关订阅服务。
分析认为，此次被纳入俄罗斯国家监控登记系统，意味着苹果未来在俄罗斯市场面临更加严格的数据存储与信息披露要求，也再次凸显全球科技企业在不同国家监管框架、隐私保护政策以及地缘政治环境之间所面临的复杂平衡挑战。

evidence.raw_lead: Apple and Microsoft have been added to a Russian state surveillance registry, requiring them to hand over users' text, video and audio messages without a legal process, and by request.
evidence.title: Russia orders Apple to surrender users' messages on demand

units.text: Apple and Microsoft have been added to a Russian state surveillance registry, requiring them to hand over users' text, video and audio messages without a legal process, and by request.

Multiple firms and apps are already on this same list, including WhatsApp and Telegram, so it's not clear why it has taken until now for Apple to be added. It's a continuation of the country's moves to control users' messages, though, as it follows Russia's blocking of FaceTime in 2025.

According to Bloomberg, Apple and Microsoft were added to this registry of "organizers of information dissemination" on October 2, 2026. The registry is operated by the country's state media watchdog, Roskomnadzor, which previously forced Apple to remove VPN apps from the App Store.

Now that Apple is on this registry, Russian law requires it to store local users' correspondence for up to three years. That data must be stored on servers within Russia, and it must be turned over to the country's security services as required.

Neither Apple nor Microsoft has yet commented publicly on the new requirements. Apple does observe the law in its international markets, but it has also removed features if it disagrees with those laws.

So when the UK ordered unwarranted access to user data in 2025, Apple disabled its Advanced Data Protection feature solely in that country. Plus it continues to not offer many features, and now also the HomeView, in the EU because of disputes over regulatory conditions.
Russia's demands on Apple and others

Back in 2022, Russian authorities fined Apple for not storing iCloud data on local servers. In that same year, Russia also made a legal requirement that major technology companies establish offices in the country.
Consequently, Apple opened an office in Moscow in February 2022.
Apple in Russia
Despite setting up that office, Apple has never had any Apple Stores in Russia. It also stopped online sales in the country in 2022 at the start of the attacks on Ukraine.

But Apple devices have been sold through third-party resellers for decades, and its services remained available to Russian subscribers until early 2026. That was at least in part because services such as the App Store are a grey area legally.
If a Russian iPhone user, for instance, subscribes to a Russian app, that in theory has nothing to do with Apple. But Apple runs the App Store and takes income from it.
So in March 2026, Apple reported itself to regulators. Since all non-US Apple sales are the responsibility of Apple Ireland, it was that division that reported the issue, and did so to UK regulators.
The UK ruled that Apple had breached sanctions against Russia "on the balance of probabilities." It fined Apple, and Apple ceased allowing such subscriptions to continue.

The registry is operated by the country's state media watchdog, Roskomnadzor, which previously forced Apple to remove VPN apps from the App Store . Now that Apple is on this registry, Russian law requires it to store local users' correspondence for up to three years. That data must be stored on servers within Russia, and it must be turned over to the country's security services as required. Neither Apple nor Microsoft has yet commented publicly on the new requirements. Apple does observe the law in its international markets, but it has also removed features if it disagrees with those laws.
Apple and Microsoft have been added to a Russian state surveillance registry, requiring them to hand over users' text, video and audio messages without a legal process, and by request.

Multiple firms and apps are already on this same list, including WhatsApp and Telegram, so it's not clear why it has taken until now for Apple to be added. It's a continuation of the country's moves to control users' messages, though, as it follows Russia's blocking of FaceTime in 2025.

According to Bloomberg, Apple and Microsoft were added to this registry of "organizers of information dissemination" on October 2, 2026. The registry is operated by the country's state media watchdog, Roskomnadzor, which previously forced Apple to remove VPN apps from the App Store.

So when the UK ordered unwarranted access to user data in 2025, Apple disabled its Advanced Data Protection feature solely in that country. Plus it continues to not offer many features, and now also the HomeView, in the EU because of disputes over regulatory conditions.

Back in 2022, Russian authorities fined Apple for not storing iCloud data on local servers. In that same year, Russia also made a legal requirement that major technology companies establish offices in the country.
Consequently, Apple opened an office in Moscow in February 2022.
Despite setting up that office, Apple has never had any Apple Stores in Russia. It also stopped online sales in the country in 2022 at the start of the attacks on Ukraine.

But Apple devices have been sold through third-party resellers for decades, and its services remained available to Russian subscribers until early 2026. That was at least in part because services such as the App Store are a grey area legally.
So in March 2026, Apple reported itself to regulators. Since all non-US Apple sales are the responsibility of Apple Ireland, it was that division that reported the issue, and did so to UK regulators.

units.text: The judge has set up the schedule for the blockbuster Apple vs. OpenAI trade theft trial, and we'll all have to wait a while for it to really get going.
Judge Edward Davila has set the Apple vs. OpenAI trial for July 19, 2027, at 9 a.m. Both companies were given until October 23 to agree on a schedule.
The dispute has roots stretching back to 2019, if not earlier. By the time the trial begins, Apple's lawsuit will have been underway for a year.

The trial schedule, spotted by 9to5Mac, also includes a June 1 deadline for the lead attorneys on both sides to meet and discuss a potential settlement. This does not mean either company is looking to settle; it is a common procedural step in federal lawsuits.
The story thus far

Apple sued OpenAI in July 2026, alleging former employees Tang Tan and Chang Liu took trade secrets to OpenAI after leaving Apple. OpenAI disputed Apple's claim that it ignored complaints, pointing to an email mixup involving Apple's lawyers.

OpenAI subsequently published an open letter defending its hires and sharing messages between Liu and former colleagues. It argued that departing employees could retain Apple files despite neither wanting them nor knowing they remained accessible.

The company's defense later focused on whether Apple adequately protected the information it described as trade secrets. Apple also accused OpenAI of introducing improper arguments as the companies fought over a preliminary injunction.

OpenAI separately alleged that an unnamed employee took its hardware secrets when returning to Apple in June 2026. Apple denied those allegations, which linked the information to HomeView despite that product's development dating back to at least 2023.

After Judge Edward Davila indicated an injunction was likely, OpenAI volunteered to avoid using Apple trade secrets during the case. It also offered forensic drive images belonging to 14 former Apple employees.

Judge Davila subsequently granted further discovery requests after Apple narrowed their scope to former employees hired by OpenAI. The order covers devices, messaging accounts, AI tools, recruitment interviews, and how OpenAI handled confidential Apple information.

evidence.title: 苹果终于让Mac能触屏了 那些年“不需要”的理由还成立吗？

units.text: 据《连线》报道，苹果为新款MacBook Pro配备触摸屏后，过去十余年间高管们反对这一功能的表态，被重新摆到了他们面前。2015年，苹果时任全球营销高级副总裁菲尔·席勒解释过，为什么iPhone、iPad适合触控，Mac却不适合。他给出了两个理由，一是使用电脑时，抬手触摸竖立的屏幕会让人不舒服；二是Mac的软件界面围绕鼠标和触控板设计，光标、菜单以及小小的窗口关闭按钮，都需要精确操作。
一年后，苹果推出配备Touch Bar触控栏的MacBook Pro，席勒再次强调，如果要让手指方便地操作屏幕，就必须重新设计菜单栏，而这又会与鼠标、触控板的操作体验发生冲突。他当时认为，两种方式无法同时得到最佳体验。
苹果甚至进行过触屏Mac的用户测试。按照席勒当时的说法，公司考虑过自己的判断可能出错，但测试最终让他们更加相信，原来的方向是对的。
如今，苹果改变了决定。
搭载M5 Pro或M5 Max芯片的新款MacBook Pro，配备支持触控的PROLED XDR显示屏，采用双层串联OLED技术。这项早已出现在许多Windows笔记本上的功能，终于进入Mac产品线。
苹果新任CEO约翰·特努斯试图淡化这次转向带来的戏剧性。他在专访中表示，Mac仍然首先是一台围绕键盘和触控板设计的电脑，但在某些场景下，触屏操作确实舒适、方便。
特努斯本人也曾表达过不同看法。2021年，他接受采访时说，Mac已经针对间接输入进行了全面优化，苹果没有感到改变这种方式的必要。
现在，他给出的解释是，苹果必须等到加入触控不会让产品在其他方面退步。电脑不能因此变厚、变重，而OLED显示屏的应用，让这些条件终于同时得到满足。
苹果首席硬件官约翰尼·斯鲁吉则把变化归因于技术进展。他表示，十年是很长的时间，显示技术、自研芯片等都发生了变化，最终芯片、屏幕和软件架构的结合达到了苹果的要求。
不过，来自用户的期待，也出现在苹果高管的解释中。
苹果全球营销高级副总裁格雷格·乔斯维亚克承认，对于需求复杂的专业用户而言，触屏功能已经让他们等得有些久了。他提到，工程师、科学家、软件开发者和媒体创作者，都希望能够直接操作屏幕。
“有一代年轻创作者和年轻用户在使用我们的MacBook Pro，他们期待屏幕可以触摸。”乔斯维亚克表示，大多数专业用户拥有iPad，几乎所有专业用户都有iPhone，对他们而言，触控已经是一种自然的操作方式。
苹果需要回答的问题随之变得具体。当年的手臂疲劳、按钮太小、屏幕晃动，如今究竟解决了多少？
根据《连线》记者看到的演示，新款MacBook Pro在常规状态下仍保留熟悉的界面。当用户用手指操作菜单项目时，相关选项会展开，方便准确选择；用于关闭、隐藏窗口的部分按钮，也会在触摸时变大。
苹果还演示了在DaVinci Resolve中进行视频调色，以及在Logic Pro中调整音轨的触控操作。Mac上的“灵动岛”也支持通过新手势展开，以类似小组件的形式呈现，方便用户查看Siri回应和使用Spotlight搜索。
硬件方面，斯鲁吉表示，苹果重新设计了屏幕铰链，以减轻手指触碰屏幕时产生的晃动。同时，公司调整了散热系统，希望用户在屏幕上进行缩放、滑动等操作时，不会觉得显示屏发烫。
《连线》记者体验了16英寸机型，认为其屏幕亮度和黑色表现十分突出。由于OLED无需背光，新机重量也比上一代更轻。
至于触屏之后难以回避的指纹问题，苹果向记者表示，新显示屏的外层抗反射涂层，可以让它无需比普通非触控屏幕更频繁地清洁。这仍是苹果给出的说法，实际使用表现有待进一步检验。
功能终于加入，价格也成为用户面前的一道门槛。
据报道，14英寸新款MacBook Pro起售价为2899美元，16英寸版起售价为3399美元。苹果将触屏首先放在面向专业用户的高端产品上，预算有限、希望购买触屏Mac的消费者，目前选择仍然有限。
提前了解过产品的金融分析师尼尔·赛巴特认为，严肃的专业用户愿意为能够改善工作方式的技术付费。不过，这并不能回答普通用户最关心的问题，触控何时会进入价格更低的Mac产品。
当记者追问MacBook Air和iMac是否也会获得触摸屏，以及可能的时间表时，特努斯拒绝透露未来产品计划。
这次采访中，苹果也没有让席勒出面回应他过去反对触屏Mac的理由。记者再次提起这位高管时，得到的是其他人的解释，以及一台已经可以用手指操作的新MacBook Pro。

evidence.title: Apple finally combined a toaster and a refrigerator

units.text: For more than 15 years, Apple has had a pretty simple answer to the idea of a touchscreen MacBook: no. Yesterday, Apple finally decided to think different and announce one anyway. “You’ve gotta touch it to believe it,” says Apple CEO John Ternus. He might be right: I haven’t yet touched it, and I still can’t quite believe it.

Steve Jobs first called touchscreen laptops “ergonomically terrible” in 2010, arguing that “touch surfaces don’t want to be vertical” and that using one for an extended period of time makes “your arm want to fall off.” He wasn’t wrong about the fatigue aspect of using a touchscreen laptop for long periods of time, but he missed the hybrid laptop opportunity Apple is now exploring.

Apple’s resistance to touchscreen Macs has been surprisingly consistent ever since Jobs’ comments. Tim Cook famously called Microsoft’s idea of hybrid laptops and tablets a compromise. “Anything can be forced to converge,” Cook said in 2012. “You can converge a toaster and a refrigerator, but those things are probably not going to be pleasing to the user.”

Craig Federighi, Apple’s software chief, described the Mac as a “sit-down experience” in a CNET interview in 2014 and proclaimed that a MacBook wasn’t “the right interface” for a touchscreen. “We’re not all that interested in building one,” he said. Four years later, he doubled down, arguing that “lifting your arm up to poke a screen is a pretty fatiguing thing to do.”

So what’s changed to make Apple reconsider touch on a MacBook? In a Wired interview, Apple’s marketing chief Greg Joswiak admitted that touch was long overdue on the Mac. “There’s a generation of young creators and young people using our MacBook Pros that expect to touch,” he said.

But most young people won’t be in a position to buy Apple’s most expensive MacBook Pro, especially with prices starting at $2,899, nearly $1,000 more than the regular MacBook Pro. Joswiak’s comment suggests that Apple could eventually bring touchscreens to more of its MacBook lineup.

Apple typically waits for hardware to mature enough before it enters a market, allowing the company to present its own version as the more refined one, superior to the alternatives. Apple appears to be doing some of that with the OLED touchscreen on the MacBook Pro. The company told Wired reporter Steven Levy that it had redesigned the hinge on the MacBook Pro screen to stabilize it and prevent wobble. It looks reasonably sturdy, though demos from yesterday show that Apple hasn’t removed the wobble completely.

Apple has also done plenty of software work to make touch feel more at home on this MacBook Pro. The menu bar has been redesigned for touch, expanding to let you select items more easily. The traffic-light buttons that let you close and minimize windows get bigger when you try to touch them, although it could take some getting used to for some.

There are also a bunch of gestures you can use on the touch display, like swiping between pages or spaces, accessing Mission Control or App Exposé, or swiping to get to the Notification Center. They’re all very similar to what you can do with the trackpad, though.

Apple hasn’t tried to reinvent the wheel here like Windows 8, or create a Yoga-style folding laptop. It’s added the touchscreen support that pro users have been demanding for years. That seems fine because touchscreens didn’t exactly revolutionize laptops in quite the way people maybe expected a decade ago.

I rarely use touchscreens on a clamshell laptop, reaching out occasionally to swipe away notifications and pinching to zoom into photos and maps. I use touch a lot more on a device like the Surface Pro, whose form factor is very different from the MacBook Pro’s.

[Image: The Dynamic Island on the new MacBook Pro. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/268836_MacBook_Pro_touchscreen_OLED_handson_ADiBenedetto_0017.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

The most interesting software addition on the touchscreen MacBook Pro is the Dynamic Island, which originally debuted on the iPhone 14 Pro four years ago. On this touchscreen MacBook Pro, you can tap it to access quick controls, and changes to brightness or volume levels will also appear on the Dynamic Island.

Apple has been cautiously adding some iPadOS features to macOS in recent years, including Stage Manager, Control Center, and even support for iPad apps on Mac. Porting across the Dynamic Island from iOS makes a lot of sense, and it could open the door to more convergence of macOS, iOS, and iPadOS over the coming years.

Apple will now need to lean on developers to support touch in their apps on macOS, something that proved tricky for the company’s previous touchscreen MacBook effort. A decade ago, almost to the day, Apple announced the Touch Bar, calling it “revolutionary.” The touchscreen strip replaced the MacBook Pro’s function keys in 2016, but it never caught on, frustrating users with inconsistent app support before Apple finally scrapped it seven years later in 2023.

I’d expect it will be a different situation this time around, though, particularly as app developers have gotten used to the idea of touchscreens on Windows for more than a decade now. Apple has also enabled the basics like scrolling and pinch to zoom, so there might not be a huge need for developers to add much to their apps.

Speaking of Windows, I’m sure there are plenty inside Microsoft who will feel vindicated by Apple’s touchscreen decision. Cook’s comment about a toaster-refrigerator certainly caught the attention of Microsoft’s Windows and Surface teams. Former Windows chief Terry Myerson even surprised former Surface chief Panos Panay with a 3D rendering of a toaster and a refrigerator during the introduction of the Surface Pro 4 in 2015.
[Image: Microsoft’s toaster-refrigerator joke. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/chrome_JfVSnUI3hP.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

Apple spent years dismissing the idea of a touchscreen Mac while Microsoft spent years trying to make touch work on laptops. Windows Vista first got some limited touch support 20 years ago, before Microsoft expanded on this with full multitouch support in Windows 7 and a massive effort to overhaul Windows 8 for touchscreens and hybrid laptops and tablets.

units.text: The new MacBook Pro brings with it a bunch of firsts for Apple laptops, the two flashiest being an OLED display and touchscreen functionality. But as an image-accuracy enthusiast, trained calibrator, and resident display expert, what excites me most about the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is the technology it uses to display an accurate picture. It’s the first laptop, and only the second product overall, to support Apple CMF 2026 color modes. It could be the future for displays.

CMFs, or color-matching functions, mathematically represent how we perceive color, and there are a few different variations. The specification that’s been the standard for years is CIE 1931 (CIE stands for Commission Internationale de l’Éclairage, or International Commission on Illumination). For nearly a century, CIE 1931 has been a reliable calibration target, and most of the reference modes on the new MacBook use it.

But with the development of new display technologies over the past 20 years that have ultra-narrow band spectra — such as OLED, LEDs with KSF phosphors, and quantum dots — CIE 1931’s shortcomings are increasingly apparent. Even when calibrated to the same D65 white point, the same image on an OLED and quantum dot LED can look identical to one person, but different to another because of biological variations in our eyes. We all have small discrepancies in our eyes — such as the sensitivity of the cones in our eyes, which allow us to see color — and those can change as we age. CIE 1931 doesn’t properly handle that and was created based on only 17 test subjects. It’s not ideal in a professional setting where content needs to look the same regardless of the screen technology it’s on or who’s viewing it. Apple CMF 2026 addresses that, so that displays look the same regardless of the technology they use.

Apple first included its new CMF on the Studio Display XDR, which I reviewed earlier this year and found to be an excellent, albeit expensive, monitor for color professionals because of Apple CMF 2026 and the reference color modes. But the fact that this technology is now on a laptop that’s portable and not just a standalone monitor living on a desk is a big help for professionals on the move.

As on the Studio Display XDR, the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display has two Apple CMF 2026 reference modes — one for P3 color primaries and one that includes both P3 and Adobe RGB color primaries for more flexibility. Peak brightness with both HDR and SDR content is 2,000 nits (on the XDR monitor peak SDR luminance is up to 1,000 nits), and the True Tone setting automatically adjusts HDR tone mapping, brightness, and white point based on ambient lighting. (An option to disable True Tone is in Displays preferences.)

The MacBook doesn’t require using Apple CMF 2026, as there are 14 more reference color modes that use the CIE 1931 color space — it is still the standard, after all — including DICOM for medical imaging (which is cool, but only useful to those in the medical field). The MacBook also supports Apple Pro Display Calibrator, which includes three calibration methods to adjust the reference color modes, or a custom mode, if necessary. There are options for a full calibration or to fine-tune a calibration with the proper measurement gear, or to visually fine-tune the display.

Color science and display technologies have come a long way since 1931, when the CIE 1931 color space was established. Apple’s development of the Apple CMF 2026 and its standardization efforts — the company is currently working with a CIE technical committee on a proposed standard — is an important step to make sure current display technologies look the same to as many people as possible.

Extending support to the new MacBook expands the user base considerably (let’s face it, more people are buying a touchscreen MacBook, even at $2,900, than a $3,300 professional monitor). And more importantly, it gives professionals that can get the most out of it easier, portable access.

units.text: Apple TV has a new crime thriller premiering tonight—Nocturne—and early reviews indicate it could be another hit series for the streamer.
Nocturne reviews praise Stephen Graham’s chilling performance as serial killer
Apple TV has a new crime series debuting tonight at 9:00 p.m. ET / 6:00 p.m. PT that sounds well worth a watch.
Nocturne stars Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz, and Stephen Graham, with Graham as a serial killer who makes the show “impossible to stop watching” per The Guardian.
Reviews for the show praise Graham’s chilling performance, which follows his award-winning turn in Adolescence last year on Netflix. Here are a couple quotes:
Los Angeles Times: “Graham is a great actor and as Walter, he’s as creepy as he needs to be, with some extra creepiness stirred in…he recalls Anthony Hopkins’ Hannibal Lecter”
The A.V. Club: ”Apple TV delivers a knockout thriller in Nocturne…much like its page-turning source material, the journey is an addictive ride to that destination.”
Not every review is effusive, as some found the series too slow in the early episodes. But by and large, critics find the show compelling.
Here’s Apple’s official series summary, followed by the trailer:

The series tells the story of Jonah Lynn (Liev Schreiber), an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter (Stephen Graham), Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek’s last missing victim forces Jonah to send his surrogate daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer (Zazie Beetz), up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?
Nocturne is based on the bestselling crime novels “Lazarus” and “The Sandman” by Lars Kepler.
The first two episodes of the show drop tonight, followed by weekly releases through December 25.
You can watch Nocturne here on Apple TV.
Have you watched Nocturne’s premiere yet? Let us know what you thought via the comments.
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.

units.text: 美国加州北区联邦地区法院法官爱德华·达维拉已将苹果起诉OpenAI及相关人员的商业机密案排定于2027年7月19日上午9时开庭。法院10月28日发布案件管理命令，规定双方须在开庭前完成文件交换、事实调查取证、专家证据和审前动议等程序。
按法院排期，双方需在2027年2月5日前基本完成文件提交，3月12日结束事实调查取证，4月28日结束专家取证；达维拉计划于6月10日听取证据专家及其他实质性动议，6月24日举行最终审前会议。双方首席律师还须在6月1日会面，讨论和解可能性、联合审前文件及缩小争议范围。这是联邦民事案件的常规程序安排，并不代表双方已经决定和解。
苹果于2026年7月提起诉讼，将OpenAI、两名前苹果员工唐·谭和刘畅，以及OpenAI旗下相关实体和io Products列为被告。苹果指控两名前员工离职后将涉及产品设计与技术的商业机密带到OpenAI，协助其消费级硬件研发；OpenAI否认苹果的说法，并表示相关员工可能是在不知情的情况下仍能访问或保留了苹果文件。
双方此前围绕禁令和证据开示发生争议。苹果称OpenAI及前员工不当获取或使用机密信息，要求法院限制其使用相关资料；OpenAI则承诺在诉讼期间不使用苹果商业机密。法院近期还批准苹果进一步调取与OpenAI聘用的苹果前员工有关的部分设备、通信、招聘面谈及内部处理机密资料的记录。案件目前仍处于证据收集阶段，法院尚未裁定苹果关于商业机密被盗用的指控是否成立。

units.text: 快科技10月30日消息，苹果日前发布新款MacBook Pro，搭载PROLED XDR屏幕，同时也是苹果旗下首款触摸屏笔记本。
可这款笔记本刚上线不久，有细心网友就揪出猫腻：同一张宣传物料，全球官网版本居然不一样。
中美官网的主图里，模特用拇指+食指比出C形手势，直观演示触屏操作。可点开韩国官网，画面直接大换血：模特一只手放在键盘打字，另一只手轻点屏幕，根本没有C手势，连拍摄场景都换了。
在韩国这边，同位置直接换成了另一张图，人物一只手放在键盘上打字，另一只手点触触摸屏，全程没出现“C”这个手势，甚至连场景都换了。
不仅如此，同款操作还出现在了同期的新款iPad mini上。
前几天，苹果更新的OLED版iPad mini上，这款新机主打5.4mm超薄机身，中、美官网都用了“手指捏住平板侧边”的画面来凸显厚度。结果到了韩国页面，这只手被修得干干净净，整张海报只剩下孤零零的平板机身。
这不禁让人好奇，本来好好的全球统一物料，为啥到了韩国就要改？原因就出在这个“C字手势”上。
据悉，在韩国，拇指与食指捏合形成的C手势长期充满争议，被不少网友当成带有冒犯意味的符号。
此前《冒险岛》开发商Nexon，曾因宣传片里出现同款手势，舆论直接炸锅，最后只能公开道歉才平息风波。
实际上，这已经不是苹果第一次小心翼翼了。去年iPhone Air上新时，全球官网都保留了双指捏合屏幕的演示图，唯独韩国页面把所有带手势的画面全部删掉。当时网友还玩梗：苹果韩国官网没有手，成了网络热议名场面。
看得出来，这个手势避雷已经被苹果写进本地化审核清单，不是临时补救。站在大企业角度算账，修图几乎零成本；可一旦踩中文化雷区，全网声讨、被迫道歉，品牌口碑损失要高出太多。
毕竟苹果体量这么大，一旦卷入性别争议，哪边都讨不到好处，最后只会拖累销量。
不过有趣的是，苹果本来只想低调避坑，结果修图痕迹太过刻意，反倒总被网友扒出来反复讨论。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，继刷入 iOS 26 后，博主 @none25smu 在 X 平台更新贴文，展示其成功为微软 Surface Duo 2 刷入 iPhone Duo 专版的 iOS 27 系统 。 开发者透露，iOS 27 的 iPhone Duo 布局需要设备分别识别两种显示屏类型：31 对应折叠状态下的外屏（Cover Display），32 对应展开状态下的内屏（Unfolded Display）。只有系统底层正确识别这两种显示屏类型，SpringBoard（iOS 主屏幕系统）才能启用相应的 Duo 双屏布局。 从开发者公布的画面来看，目前界面缩放比例仍然存在一定问题，整体显示尺寸明显偏大。开发者也对此调侃称，当前画面的缩放比例实在太高。 此次进展意味着，该移植项目已经从此前的点亮系统、优化硬件加速，进一步推进至适配系统原生级折叠宽屏界面，不过距离日常使用仍然存在较大距离差距。

units.text: 快科技10月30日消息，苹果公司在本周推出了首款搭载触控屏的MacBook Pro。这款新品的发布意味着苹果正式推翻了坚守近20年的产品理念。此前，苹果联合创始人史蒂夫·乔布斯曾公开抨击触控Mac，称其在人体工程学上极为糟糕。
尽管支持触控操作，但苹果线上专家称，这款笔记本目前暂不支持Apple Pencil来代替手指，相关话题随即引发热议。也就是说，触控功能虽然已经落地，但苹果对触控笔的支持仍持谨慎态度。
有观点认为，触屏Mac搭配Apple Pencil，既能精准点击，还能避免屏幕留下指纹，缓解手臂操作疲劳。但这款设备并不支持Apple Pencil，这也让不少期待手写笔体验的用户感到意外。
也有人提出不同看法，觉得手写笔操作会更累；还有人把它比作新一代Touch Bar。苹果CEO约翰·特努斯表示，Mac的核心定位仍是以键盘和触控板为核心，触屏仅作为特定场景下的便捷补充。
这一表态也说明，苹果并未打算让触控取代原有的键鼠交互，而是将其视为补充能力。苹果官网显示，这款笔记本定价为22999元起，提供14英寸和16英寸两种尺寸。
如果选择顶配版本，其售价将超过12万元。两款机型均搭载PROLED XDR显示屏及灵动岛，后者已在iPhone上广泛应用，机身A面的苹果发光Logo也时隔多年重新回归。

units.text: Apple's Touchscreen MacBook Pro Could Ship 1.5M Units in 2027
Apple's new OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro could ship between 1.2 million and 1.5 million units in 2027, according to a new forecast from market intelligence firm TrendForce.

Announced on Wednesday, the new MacBook Pro is the first to feature a tandem OLED touchscreen, with pricing starting at $2,899 for the 14-inch model and $3,399 for the 16-inch model. Pre-orders are available now, with a launch coming on Friday, November 6.
Given that Apple is selling the OLED models alongside its existing mini-LED MacBook Pro lineup, TrendForce says that the premium starting price could temper near-term replacement demand.

Even so, the firm expects Apple's arrival in the OLED laptop market to accelerate the market landscape more broadly. Up until now, it has been driven mainly by Windows brands such as Lenovo, HP, and ASUS.

The overall laptop market has been contracting for two consecutive years, but TrendForce forecasts OLED laptop shipments will grow nearly 40% year-over-year in 2026, followed by another increase of more than 40% in 2027, with brands increasingly prioritizing OLED models in their product roadmaps.

Samsung Display is currently the exclusive panel supplier for the new MacBook Pro. The company has designated Phase 1 of its G8.6 A6 production line at its Asan campus in South Korea as a dedicated facility for Apple, and the MacBook Pro is the first product to enter mass production on Samsung Display's G8.6 fine metal mask (FMM) OLED line. The display's tandem OLED architecture and 254 PPI pixel density impose exceptionally demanding production requirements, particularly in material costs and manufacturing yields, notes TrendForce.

Meanwhile, rival panel makers are conducting qualification programs, but TrendForce believes the cost of meeting Apple's specifications and Samsung Display's established position present considerable barriers to entry. LG Display, BOE, and TCL CSOT are instead said to be directing their efforts toward the supply chain for the OLED MacBook Air, which isn't expected to debut until at least 2028.

evidence.discovery_title: 「史上最强」的 iPad mini，为什么还是 60Hz 屏幕？
evidence.raw_lead: 2026 款 iPad mini 配备 A20 Pro 芯片和 8.5 英寸 OLED，起售价 5499 元，却仍未支持 120Hz ProMotion。文章辨析像素响应时间与刷新率的区别，并从 iPad 产品线区隔角度分析这一取舍。
evidence.title: 「史上最强」的 iPad mini，为什么还是 60Hz 屏幕？

units.text: 「史上最强」的 iPad mini，为什么还是 60Hz 屏幕？
最近，苹果硬件工程副总裁 Dave Pakula 在接受专访时，被问到了那个所有人在新 iPad mini 发布后都在追问的问题——为什么换上了 OLED，却依然没有 120Hz ProMotion？
对此，Pakula 的解释是：
显示体验不只关乎单一参数。OLED 真正酷的地方在于它拥有极快的像素响应时间——比 LCD 快了一个数量级以上。这会让所有画面看起来都非常顺滑，运动模糊相比 LCD 大幅减少。
看似回答了很多，但其实始终没有回答那个最核心的问题——为什么都 2026 年了，一台有了诸多跨越式升级、换上 Pro 级芯片、顶配甚至破万元的小平板，偏偏不配拥有一块 120Hz 的高刷屏？
图｜YouTube @Christopher Lawley 专访截图
除了 120Hz，什么都给齐了
单看机器本身，2026 款 iPad mini 确实是近年来苹果相当激进的一次大改款，苹果自己也在新闻稿里说是「史上最大更新」（its biggest update ever）。
厚度从原本的 6.3mm 进一步压到了 5.4mm，255g 的整机重量只比 iPhone Duo 重了 1g，甚至比不少戴了保护壳的旗舰大屏手机还要轻巧。
通过屏幕微振动发声的 Acoustic Display，苹果拿掉了传统的扬声器开孔，也顺带带来了 iPad 家族史上第一个 IP67 级别抗水防尘。
图｜Apple
再加上跨代升级的 2 纳米 A20 Pro 旗舰芯片、鲜艳明亮的 8.5 英寸 OLED，甚至破天荒地下放了此前只有万元 iPad Pro 才能选配的纳米纹理玻璃——几乎所有能给的堆料，这次全被塞进了这具纤薄的机身里。
但代价是什么呢？
国行 128GB 起售价定在了 5499 元，相比上代首发价整整涨了 1500 元。如果选配纳米纹理玻璃、顶配容量并加上蜂窝网络，价格更是破天荒地越过了万元大关。
既然硬件堆得这么满、价格也卖到了这个份上，那块原地踏步的 60Hz 屏幕，就再也没法用「入门款要妥协」来掩盖了。
图｜Apple
OLED 治好了果冻屏，但变不出 120 帧
面对外界对刷新率的质疑，Dave Pakula 搬出的那套「像素响应时间论」，严格来说并没有错。
在屏幕物理层面，「像素响应时间」指的是一个像素从一种颜色切换到另一种颜色的耗时。自发光的 OLED 材料分子响应极快，变色速度可以压到 0.1 毫秒以内，比传统液晶 LCD 快了一个数量级。
响应时间的进步，确实让上一代 iPad mini 饱受诟病的果冻效应几乎不复存在，滚动时屏幕左右两侧不再会有「不同步」的感觉。
图｜Apple
但需要注意的是，「像素响应时间」与「屏幕刷新率」是两个不同维度的概念。响应时间解决的是画面过渡时的拖影与残影，而刷新率决定的则是动态画面的信息采样密度。
现代显示设备的成像大多基于「采样并保持（Sample-and-Hold）」机制——画面每刷新一帧，就会在面板上停留到下一帧到来。在 60Hz 下，画面每隔 16.67 毫秒才更新一次；而在 120Hz 下，这个间隔被压缩到了 8.33 毫秒。
OLED 极短的变色时间确实大幅改善了液晶时代的果冻屏与拖尾，但画面的物理帧率并没有改变，视觉上的流畅上限依然被固定在 60Hz，实际使用感受相比 120Hz 也是差了一大截。
图｜Monitors Unboxed，经过修改
更重要的是，国内用户的眼睛早就被「惯坏」了。在国产 Android 阵营，高刷早已不再是旗舰专属，哪怕千元出头的走量机型，也早就把 120Hz 甚至 144Hz 当成了出厂标配。
且不说一向在刀法上精打细算的苹果自己，都在今年的 iPhone 17 标准版上全系标配了 120Hz ProMotion，抹平了与 Pro 系列在屏幕上的鸿沟。
图｜iPhone 17 宣传图，来源 Apple
当大家在手机、显示器甚至各类游戏掌机上早已习惯了高刷，再回过头来划动这台 60Hz 的 iPad mini，落差感无可避免，顿挫和拖沓感也是肉眼可见。
更何况在今年的小平板大年里，友商们早把高刷这道题做成了开卷考。
如果连三千元档的 REDMI 和 OPPO 都无一例外给到了高刷，那起售价高达 5499 元的 iPad mini 再不给，实在是有点说不过去了。
在三星的供应链面板线上，单层 LTPS OLED 的 120Hz 方案早就是极其成熟的大路货。在 2026 年 5000 元以上的移动设备里，想要找到一块不高刷的 OLED 面板，难度远比找一块高刷面板大得多。
刀法很精明，但这一点都不苹果
当小尺寸、超薄机身与供应链量产都已具备成熟方案，苹果依然选择将刷新率停留在 60Hz，理由其实只剩下了一个——为了保住自家产品线的等级。对于平板来说，屏幕几乎就是体验的全部。买平板，本质上就是买一块屏幕。
而在苹果当下的产品线里，屏幕刷新率依然是一道不能轻易逾越的界线。今年 3 月更新的 iPad Air 依然被留在 60Hz LCD 屏幕上，而 120Hz ProMotion 则是 10799 元起售的 iPad Pro 最核心的区隔标志。
图｜Apple
如果苹果真给这台 5499 元、搭载 A20 Pro 旗舰芯片的小平板配上一块 120Hz OLED，整条产品线就会面临内部碰撞——
一方面，同价位还在用 60Hz LCD 的 iPad Air 处境会变得非常尴尬；另一方面，一部分原本冲着顶级便携屏幕去买 iPad Pro 的用户，也可能会转向这台尺寸更小巧的 mini。
为了保住森严的产品序列，苹果宁愿专门按 60Hz 的规格定制这块 OLED 面板，宁愿让工程主管出面解释「响应时间比单一参数更重要」，都不愿意在这块 8.5 英寸的屏幕上给用户一个哪怕是 90Hz 的高刷。
图｜Apple
在商言商，这样的刀法并不难理解，只是对苦等了那么多年的 iPad mini 用户来说，好不容易盼到换上 OLED、机身全方位大改款，以为终于有了高刷的指望，结果一公布，悬着的心终于彻底死了。
但话又说回来，如果在未来，这台机器的价格能有所下探，或许会像当年的 iPhone XR 一样——
随着价格越来越低，边框越来越窄、屏幕越来越清晰、甚至滑动也越来越流畅，慢慢演变成大众口中的另一款「真香机」。
只是在 2026 年的今天，当几乎所有人都已经习惯了高刷的流畅，当这种丝滑成为一种无需言说的日常体验，每当拿起 iPad mini 划动时，偶尔出现的顿挫感也还是会让人如鲠在喉。

recorded_extraction: 「史上最强」的 iPad mini，为什么还是 60Hz 屏幕？

2026 款 iPad mini 配备 A20 Pro 芯片和 8.5 英寸 OLED，起售价 5499 元，却仍未支持 120Hz ProMotion。文章辨析像素响应时间与刷新率的区别，并从 iPad 产品线区隔角度分析这一取舍。 最近，苹果硬件工程副总裁 Dave Pakula 在接受专访时，被问到了那个所有人在新 iPad mini 发布后都在追问的问题——为什么换上了 OLED，却依然没有 120Hz ProMotion？ 显示体验不只关乎单一参数。OLED 真正酷的地方在于它拥有极快的像素响应时间——比 LCD 快了一个数量级以上。这会让所有画面看起来都非常顺滑，运动模糊相比 LCD 大幅减少。 看似回答了很多，但其实始终没有回答那个最核心的问题——为什么都 2026 年了，一台有了诸多跨越式升级、换上 Pro 级芯片、顶配甚至破万元的小平板，偏偏不配拥有一块 120Hz 的高刷屏？ 单看机器本身，2026 款 iPad mini 确实是近年来苹果相当激进的一次大改款，苹果自己也在新闻稿里说是「史上最大更新」（its biggest update ever）。
单看机器本身，2026 款 iPad mini 确实是近年来苹果相当激进的一次大改款，苹果自己也在新闻稿里说是「史上最大更新」（its biggest update ever）。
厚度从原本的 6.3mm 进一步压到了 5.4mm，255g 的整机重量只比 iPhone Duo 重了 1g，甚至比不少戴了保护壳的旗舰大屏手机还要轻巧。
通过屏幕微振动发声的 Acoustic Display，苹果拿掉了传统的扬声器开孔，也顺带带来了 iPad 家族史上第一个 IP67 级别抗水防尘。
再加上跨代升级的 2 纳米 A20 Pro 旗舰芯片、鲜艳明亮的 8.5 英寸 OLED，甚至破天荒地下放了此前只有万元 iPad Pro 才能选配的纳米纹理玻璃——几乎所有能给的堆料，这次全被塞进了这具纤薄的机身里。
国行 128GB 起售价定在了 5499 元，相比上代首发价整整涨了 1500 元。如果选配纳米纹理玻璃、顶配容量并加上蜂窝网络，价格更是破天荒地越过了万元大关。
既然硬件堆得这么满、价格也卖到了这个份上，那块原地踏步的 60Hz 屏幕，就再也没法用「入门款要妥协」来掩盖了。
在屏幕物理层面，「像素响应时间」指的是一个像素从一种颜色切换到另一种颜色的耗时。自发光的 OLED 材料分子响应极快，变色速度可以压到 0.1 毫秒以内，比传统液晶 LCD 快了一个数量级。
现代显示设备的成像大多基于「采样并保持（Sample-and-Hold）」机制——画面每刷新一帧，就会在面板上停留到下一帧到来。在 60Hz 下，画面每隔 16.67 毫秒才更新一次；而在 120Hz 下，这个间隔被压缩到了 8.33 毫秒。

且不说一向在刀法上精打细算的苹果自己，都在今年的 iPhone 17 标准版上全系标配了 120Hz ProMotion，抹平了与 Pro 系列在屏幕上的鸿沟。

evidence.title: 风扇、传感器、背光拆成独立驱动！Intel Mac的SMC代码终于要现代化了

units.text: 快科技10月30日消息，Intel Mac用户在Linux下的硬件支持即将迎来一次底层重构。开发者Atharva Tiwari近日向内核邮件列表提交了14个RFC补丁。
他计划用为Apple Silicon开发的macsmc驱动框架，全面取代服役多年的applesmc驱动，让Intel Mac的SMC支持获得与M系列芯片同等级别的模块化能力。
applesmc驱动的问题在于架构陈旧。它将风扇控制、温度传感器、光线传感器、运动传感器和键盘背光全部塞进单一文件，且通信方式独成一套，导致代码难以扩展，新机型适配成本很高。
而SMC在Intel Mac与Apple Silicon上的工作方式本质相同，差异仅在于与芯片的通信路径，这为代码复用提供了基础。
补丁集的第一步是架构拆分。macsmc驱动被拆分为通用核心与后端两层，原本为Apple Silicon准备的RTKit通信代码移入独立后端，同时新增一个专为Intel Mac设计的ACPI后端。该后端支持传统的I/O端口、MMIO以及中断驱动完成机制，这些能力applesmc并不具备。
在此基础上，原本臃肿的单体驱动被切分为多个职责单一的小驱动，统一使用标准内核接口。
新增内容包括基于SMC的看门狗驱动，可在系统无响应时重置机器；IIO框架下的光线与加速度传感器驱动；以及键盘背光LED驱动。RTC、电源供应和hwmon也获得了针对Intel Mac的专门支持。
电源管理同样被重新接管。在启用macsmc-power的Intel Mac上，内核会主动禁用acpi-sbs以及ACPI电池与适配器驱动，避免新旧两套机制产生重复设备。
hwmon部分还补充了Intel Mac常用的有符号定点数等数据类型，解决了旧驱动无法读取部分SMC键值的问题。
作者已在MacBook Pro 16,1、iMac 20,1、MacBook Air 4,2、MacBook Pro 12,1和MacBook Pro 15,1等多款Intel机型上完成测试，仅运动传感器驱动因未找到对应硬件而尚未验证。
目前该系列以RFC形式提交，目的是先就架构方向获取维护者反馈，后续将扩展测试范围并作为正式补丁重新提交。

units.text: Apple has acquired another AI firm, though this time Ascend.io is aimed at company data management rather than any consumer-facing product.

Apple has been continuously buying up AI firms, with the most recent ones being for specific features such as Huxe's automated podcast creation. This time, though, it has bought Ascend.io from Silicon Valley firm Ascension Labs in order to improve its own internal data management.

According to the EU's public listing of significant acquisitions, Apple closed the deal on June 30, 2026. Apple appears to have adopted new processes, though, as this purchase is again not specified as an acquisition.
Instead, as it was with Huxe and also audio editing firm Samplab, Apple is listed as having the right to "make employment offers to and hire certain employees" of the firm.
Apple also gets a "non-exclusive license to Ascend's intellectual property rights," as well as at least some of its patents. So in theory, other firms could yet license the same data tools.
In practice, it's presumably going to mean that the company's existing clients can continue using it. That client list is impressive, too, including:
News Corp
Marist
HarperCollins
Mattel

units.text: 苹果公司近日再次完成一项与人工智能相关的收购交易，不过与此前面向消费者功能的AI技术不同，此次目标是一家专注于企业数据管理领域的公司Ascend.io。此举显示苹果正持续加强自身在人工智能时代的数据处理与管理能力。
根据欧盟公布的重要收购交易清单显示，苹果已于2026年6月30日完成与Ascend.io相关交易。值得注意的是，与苹果近期多笔类似交易一样，这项交易并未被明确标注为传统意义上的“收购”。
公开信息显示，苹果获得了向Ascend.io部分员工提供工作机会并聘用相关人员的权利。这种操作方式与苹果此前涉及AI播客生成技术公司Huxe以及音频编辑技术公司Samplab的交易模式相似。
除了吸纳人才之外，苹果还获得了Ascend.io知识产权的非独占许可，同时取得了该公司至少部分专利资产。这意味着理论上其他企业仍有可能继续获得或授权使用Ascend.io开发的数据管理技术。
Ascend.io母公司Ascension Labs也已在官方网站发布业务终止公告。公告表示，公司正在逐步结束运营，并为“下一段伟大冒险”做准备。不过公告中并未提及苹果，也未说明与任何收购交易相关的细节。
报道称，Ascend.io的核心业务主要围绕企业级数据管理，而非直接面向普通消费者的产品。因此，与苹果过往一些能够迅速转化为用户可感知功能的收购不同，这项交易短期内预计不会直接体现在苹果面向消费者的软件或硬件产品上。
业内观察认为，此次交易更可能服务于苹果内部人工智能系统建设。近年来，苹果持续通过收购获得AI技术、人才和知识产权资源，从自动化内容生成到音频处理，再到数据管理能力，不断扩充其人工智能技术版图，为未来产品和服务的发展提供底层支撑。

units.text: Apple recently struck a deal to acquire Ascend.io, a company focused on agentic data engineering technology.

Under the Digital Markets Act, Apple must now publicly report acquisitions above a certain size. This has given us new insight into the company’s acquisition strategy, including glimpses at its future goals.
The latest update to the EU’s “List of Acquisitions” website reveals a deal between Apple and Ascension Labs, Inc., perhaps better known as Ascend.io.

This is a typical acquihire situation, with Apple’s update saying it “will have the right to make employment offers to and hire certain employees” of Ascension Labs. The deal also includes a “non-exclusive license to Ascend’s intellectual property rights.” Apple will also be able to “be assigned certain patents” owned by the company.

Ascend.io describes itself as “the first Agentic Data Engineering platform,” with AI agents that “automatically handle all the tedious stuff” associated with data engineering. The company was founded in 2015.
Ascend.io’s website has also been updated with the following note:

For the past ten years we pursued a singular mission: Make Data Engineering Delightful. We introduced the industry’s first declarative data pipeline technology. We launched a unified platform that brought all of ingest, transform, and orchestration together. We invented DataAware automation. And most recently we pioneered Agentic Data Engineering — where agents work alongside teams across the entire data engineering lifecycle. Each chapter was different, but the goal the same: make life better for data engineers.
Earlier this month, Apple also struck a deal with an AI startup that lets musicians rework recorded music.

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple chose to have perhaps four times more iPhone Duo stock at retail than for sale online on launch day, and even so, most went home empty-handed. Apple arranged its limited iPhone Duo stock so that most went to Apple Stores instead of to online pre-orders. Apple described demand for the iPhone Duo as being "extraordinary," and manufacturer Foxconn has talked about using its international facilities to produce more. Certainly the pre-order stock sold out instantaneously, although a new report suggests there was a reason for that. According to Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman, Apple elected to route the greater number of iPhone Duo units to Apple Stores instead of keeping them for online pre-orders. Citing people said to be close to Apple's logistics planning, he says on his " Power On " podcast that as much as 80% of the stock was reserved for the stores. units.text: Apple chose to have perhaps four times more iPhone Duo stock at retail than for sale online on launch day, and even so, most went home empty-handed.

Apple described demand for the iPhone Duo as being "extraordinary," and manufacturer Foxconn has talked about using its international facilities to produce more. Certainly the pre-order stock sold out instantaneously, although a new report suggests there was a reason for that.

According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple elected to route the greater number of iPhone Duo units to Apple Stores instead of keeping them for online pre-orders. Citing people said to be close to Apple's logistics planning, he says on his "Power On" podcast that as much as 80% of the stock was reserved for the stores.

Apple never publishes figures about how many iPhones it makes, let alone how it apportions them across its retail channels. But it is always true that a certain amount are reserved for online pre-orders, and a certain amount go to stores.
In this case, though, reportedly not only did Apple reserve just 20% of its inventory for online, that included online pickup orders. So that 80% was aimed at walk-in buyers.
Proportions, but no figures

Without any actual figures, though, it's still unlikely that Apple had very many of the iPhone Duo in stores. Apple itself said stocks would be limited, and based on all information possible, that seemed to be optimistic.

Even so, Apple pushed back some when we said that iPhone Duo quantities were going to be extremely limited in the stores. We asked them to provide numbers, and we never heard back from them on the matter.
Now according to Gurman, some stores got around 50, and the biggest flagship stores may have had up to 250.
When a store gets 50 iPhone Duos to sell, when they previously got hundreds of the iPhone X, or thousands of the iPhone 18 Pro, that sounds extremely limited to us.

units.text: 苹果日前发布全新一代iPad mini，但和以往一样，并未在官方规格页面中直接公布电池容量数据。随着监管文件和设备信息陆续曝光，这款小尺寸平板的电池配置终于得到确认。
资料显示，新款iPad mini内置18.9Wh电池。按照标称电压换算，其电池容量约为5078mAh。尽管这一数字已经公开，但苹果依旧延续了不直接标注毫安时容量的做法，而是采用瓦时（Wh）作为官方电池参数。
从规格对比来看，新机在电池容量方面与上一代产品保持接近水平。与此同时，苹果将重点放在显示技术、芯片性能以及机身设计等方面的升级上。新款iPad mini首次采用OLED显示屏，搭载A20 Pro处理器，并继续支持Apple Pencil系列配件。
除了核心硬件升级之外，新机还采用了全新的“Acoustic Display”声学显示技术，将扬声器系统进一步整合至屏幕结构之中。苹果表示，这一方案能够带来更强的低频表现和更高的音量输出。
机身设计方面，新款iPad mini厚度缩减至5.4毫米，重量降至255克，相比上一代的6.3毫米厚度和297克重量更加轻薄便携。网络连接部分则升级至Wi‑Fi 7，蜂窝版支持5G连接，并搭载苹果自研通信方案。
续航方面，尽管电池容量数据已经揭晓，但苹果仍维持与此前相似的官方续航定位。同时，新机通过USB‑C接口充电，并支持更高功率的充电器，官方称在使用35W或更高功率适配器时，30分钟可充入约50%的电量。

Apple allocated roughly 80% of its initial iPhone Duo inventory to its retail stores, with locations holding as few as 50 units each, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

Speaking on the latest episode of his Power On podcast, Gurman, citing people very close to the device's logistics, said most customers who bought a Duo in store on day one got one by waiting in line.

Flagship stores were said to have held up to around 250 units, and Fifth Avenue was stocked unusually heavily because Apple executives attended the launch. The inventory split helps explain why pre-orders slipped to late January within minutes on October 16, while most people who queued on launch day walked away with a new phone.

At the time, Apple described demand as "nothing short of extraordinary" and said it was working to satisfy demand "as quickly as possible," so there's a good chance that, even if a delivery estimate for your order is way out in the future, it could improve over time.
Where to Buy iPhone Duo: Stores, Pickup, and Wait Times
Just Got an iPhone Duo? Try These Features First

units.text: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，苹果于 10 月 26 日发布了新款 iPad mini（A20 Pro），将于 11 月 6 日起正式发售，售价 5499 元起。
IT之家注意到，该机 128GB（5499 元起）/ 256GB（6299 元起）存储版本机型的 A20 Pro 芯片为“5 核中央处理器、7 核图形处理器、16 核神经网络引擎”规格，仅有顶配 512GB 机型（7999 元起）为“6 核中央处理器、7 核图形处理器、双 16 核神经网络引擎”规格。
目前，这款产品的 Geekbench 7 跑分已经曝光，均搭载 12GB 内存，其中 5 核 CPU 版单核跑分 3879，多核跑分 9870；6 核 CPU 版单核跑分 3993，多核跑分 11365。
此外，Geekbench 显示，两个版本的 CPU 频率均为 4.93 GHz，与 iPhone 18 Pro 系列手机上的 A20 Pro 芯片相同。

evidence.title: 新款OLED版iPad mini跑分曝光：单核性能反超部分iPad Pro 多核较前代大幅提升

units.text: 苹果于本周正式发布搭载OLED显示屏和A20 Pro芯片的新一代iPad mini（2026），该产品将于11月6日开始向首批消费者发货。在正式开售前，一台新机已经现身Geekbench 7数据库，其性能表现也随之曝光。
此次测试设备型号为iPad19，2，对应蜂窝网络版（Wi‑Fi + Cellular）机型。Geekbench 7测试结果显示，其单核成绩达到3879分，多核成绩为9870分。数据库信息显示，这颗处理器采用五核CPU设计，包括两个性能核心和三个能效核心，其中性能核心最高频率达到4.93GHz。
从配置特征来看，参与测试的设备应为128GB或256GB存储版本。苹果在这些容量版本中使用了经过精简的A20 Pro芯片，屏蔽了一颗能效核心，因此CPU总核心数为五个。只有512GB版本配备完整的六核A20 Pro处理器。这并非苹果首次采用类似策略，上一代iPad mini所搭载的A17 Pro同样属于经过裁剪的版本。
跑分信息还显示，新款iPad mini配备12GB内存。不过，与苹果一贯做法相同，这一规格并未出现在官方营销资料中。
作为对比，搭载完整六核A20 Pro芯片的iPhone 18 Pro Max在Geekbench 7中的成绩约为单核4024分、多核11424分。这意味着新款iPad mini单核性能仅落后约4%，多核性能落后约14%，这一差距与其缺少一个CPU核心的情况基本吻合。
与前代产品相比，新机则实现了显著提升。上一代iPad mini的Geekbench 7成绩约为单核2638分、多核7103分。按照这一数据计算，新款机型单核性能提升约47%，多核性能提升约39%，性能跃升幅度十分明显。
如果将其与苹果的大尺寸平板进行比较，结果则更加有意思。搭载M5芯片的13英寸iPad Pro在Geekbench 7中的成绩约为单核3580分、多核15126分。新款iPad mini的单核成绩反而高出约8%，不过在多核性能方面，iPad Pro仍领先约53%。
面对搭载M4芯片的13英寸iPad Air，其Geekbench 7成绩约为单核3206分、多核12686分。新款iPad mini单核性能领先约21%，而iPad Air则在多核测试中领先约29%。
这些结果表明，虽然苹果最新的小尺寸平板在单线程性能方面已经具备相当强的竞争力，甚至能够超越部分定位更高的iPad产品，但在需要大量并行计算的多线程任务中，拥有更多核心数的M系列处理器依然保持明显优势。
价格方面，iPad mini（2026）起售价为699美元、749欧元或699英镑，目前已开启预订。

据悉，苹果本周已经向全国所有Apple Store零售店以及第三方授权服务提供商下发了专项操作指引，要求门店在收到用户上报的iPhone Duo内屏开裂问题之后，技术人员必须按照统一规范流程做检测核验，确认故障后按照标准售后流程为用户维修或者直接更换全新设备。
这份内部下发的指引里，苹果依然沿用了此前的公开声明口径，对外强调目前只有非常少量的iPhone Duo设备出现了内屏开裂的故障问题，没有大范围扩散。
苹果此前针对该问题发布的公开回应表述是，首批用户对iPhone Duo的使用反馈整体非常好，开发者也在快速更新各类应用适配这款产品独特的新形态，已经带来了不少亮眼的使用成果。
他们留意到确实有少量iPhone Duo设备存在内屏故障问题，如果用户遇到iPhone Duo屏幕相关故障，可以直接联系苹果官方客服AppleCare申请免费更换。
行业人士认为，苹果这次悄悄向下游全渠道下发专项操作指引的行为本身就很有代表性，说明iPhone Duo内屏开裂的实际影响范围大概率已经超出了苹果最初的预期，否则完全没必要专门给全国所有售后网点统一下发标准化处理的操作规范，要求所有人按照统一口径执行。
苹果官方明确表示，目前没有针对iPhone Duo的内屏故障推出整机召回的相关计划，截至目前也还没有在官方网站上针对这个问题发布面向公众公开的专属维修保障方案。
作为苹果阔屏新形态的首款试水产品，这次内屏故障事件本质上暴露了赶工期推出的全新形态产品，在供应链品控层面很容易出现大面积踩坑的问题，如果苹果一直拖着不拿出更有诚意的全面保障方案，后续这类集中爆发的质量问题很可能会直接透支用户对苹果创新产品的信任度。

evidence.title: 苹果 Apple 智能国行版官宣落地：接入阿里千问，11 月 4 日随 iOS 开发者 Beta 版开放测试

units.text: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，苹果今日宣布首批 Apple 智能功能即将在中国推出，并与阿里巴巴达成合作，在部分体验中接入千问。这是 Apple 智能自 2024 年发布以来，国行版本首次获得实质性落地进展。
这一系列 Apple 智能功能将自 11 月 4 日起随最新的 iOS 开发者 Beta 版开放测试，并将于 12 月 iOS 27.3 正式发布时面向中国用户推出。其他平台的支持将在获得必要审批后推出。
根据苹果公布的信息，中国用户可直接在 Siri、写作工具和视觉智能中调用千问，覆盖文本与图像理解相关能力。
苹果用户登录千问账户，或通过“通过 Apple 登录”，即可在系统内访问千问，无需跳转至独立应用。阿里巴巴方面此前曾确认，千问的集成范围将延伸至 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS。
首批向中国用户开放的功能以基础高频场景为主。实时翻译集成在信息、FaceTime 通话和电话 App 中，并支持 AirPods 4 及 AirPods Pro 2 及后续机型进行面对面对话翻译。写作工具提供改写、校对与摘要；视觉智能通过摄像头识别周围物体与场所；照片 App 的消除工具可去除画面中的干扰对象。
此外，智绘表情支持通过文字描述生成表情符号，照片 App 新增自然语言搜索与回忆影片创建。邮件与通知侧则包含优先邮件、生成摘要、智能回复、通知摘要和首要通知等整理类功能。备忘录 App 和通话录音的转写文本可自动生成摘要。
IT之家提醒：本次更新不包含 Siri AI，也不包含苹果在 WWDC 2026 上宣布的其他下一代 Apple 智能功能。
▲ 照片 App 的清除工具可去除干扰对象，同时原样呈现拍摄当时的意境。
▲ 写作工具可帮助用户改写、校对和摘要输入的文本。
以下是 Apple 即将在支持的 iPhone 上向中国用户推出的首批功能：
实时翻译功能帮助用户在发送信息或交谈时跨特定语言进行交流，并无缝整合在信息、FaceTime 通话和电话 App 中。用户还可通过支持主动降噪的 AirPods 4，以及 AirPods Pro 2 及后续机型使用该功能，实时翻译面对面对话。
写作工具可帮助用户改写、校对和摘要输入的文本。
视觉智能帮助用户通过 iPhone 摄像头即时了解周围的物体和场所。
照片 App 的消除工具可去除干扰对象，同时原样呈现拍摄当时的意境。
智绘表情让用户仅需输入文字描述，便可生成专属于自己的表情符号。
照片 App 中的自然语言搜索让用户只需输入一段描述，就能更轻松地寻找某张照片或某段视频。
用户仅需输入描述即可在照片 App 中创建回忆影片。
邮件 App 收件箱顶部的优先邮件区域会显示最紧急的电子邮件，例如当日的午餐邀请或登机牌。
邮件摘要让用户只需轻点“生成摘要”，即可查看某封电子邮件或长邮件对话的关键要点。
智能回复可在邮件 App 和信息 App 中为用户生成快速答复文本建议。
通知摘要直接在锁定屏幕上提供关键信息，方便用户速览篇幅较长或分类叠放的通知。
首要通知会将最紧急的事项置于通知顶部，让用户立即看到可能需要关注的事项。
减少干扰专注模式仅会推送需要立刻处理的通知。
备忘录 app 中的音频转录摘要会自动生成，让重要信息一目了然。
用户可生成通话转录文本的摘要，凸显重要细节。
Siri 变得更加自然且实用。用户可使用输入文字与 Siri 对话功能，即使用户在表述时不够连贯，Siri 也能准确理解其意图，并在连续的对话中保持上下文的连贯。
在处理特定请求时，Siri 能够接入千问，利用其广博的知识为用户提供协助。用户还可以针对照片以及包含 PDF 与演示文稿的文档进行提问。只需登录千问账户，或使用通过 Apple 登录，用户即可在 Apple 智能中顺畅访问千问。
借助创作功能，用户可以直接在系统全局的写作工具中，让千问从零开始创作原创内容。
▲ 实时翻译功能无缝整合在信息、FaceTime 通话和电话 App 中，帮助用户在发送信息或交谈时跨特定语言进行交流。
▲ 实时翻译功能无缝整合在信息、FaceTime 通话和电话 App 中，帮助用户在发送信息或交谈时跨特定语言进行交流。
▲ 智绘表情让用户仅需输入文字描述，便可生成专属于自己的表情符号。
▲ 邮件 app 收件箱顶部的优先邮件区域会显示最紧急的电子邮件，例如当日的午餐邀请或登机牌。
▲ 邮件摘要让用户只需轻点“生成摘要”，即可查看某封电子邮件或长邮件对话的关键要点。
▲ 首要通知会将最紧急的事项置于通知顶部，让用户立即看到可能需要关注的事项。
▲ 用户可在电话 app 和备忘录 app 中将录制的音频转写成文字，Apple 智能还可为转写的文字生成摘要。
▲ Siri 变得更加自然且实用。用户可使用输入文字与 Siri 对话功能。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，太平洋时间 10 月 28 日上午 10 点（北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨 1 点）在洛杉矶举行的“Pro and Tell”体验活动结束后，法国 Numerama 网站记者 Nicolas Lellouche 现场体验并和苹果代表交流后，梳理了苹果首款触控 MacBook Pro 的 15 个要点细节。
IT之家援引博文介绍，附上 15 个要点细节如下：
触控不是主要交互方式：苹果不期待用户每天都用屏幕触控；触控板和键盘仍是 MacBook Pro 的优先交互方式。
苹果仍认同乔布斯的观点：苹果认为乔布斯关于“抬着手触屏不方便”的判断依然成立，因此没有把触屏当作笔记本的核心操作逻辑。
触控可以关闭：用户可在“辅助功能”设置中关闭触控屏。
发光苹果标志也可关闭：除了触控，机身背后发光的 Apple 标志同样可以在设置中关闭。
触控是技术机会，而非独立部件：触控功能不是额外加装的一层，而是直接集成在 Tandem OLED 面板中。
OLED 才是首要目标：MacBook Pro 的优先目标是提供“电影级参考级”的 OLED 屏幕；触控只是这块屏幕顺带具备的能力。
部分创作者早有需求：苹果称，一些创作者长期以来一直希望 MacBook 具备触控功能。
当前目标用户是创作者：这款触控 MacBook Pro 目前主要面向创作者，而不是所有普通用户。
年轻创作者更习惯触控：苹果认为，成长于触屏设备的一代年轻创作者，使用触控时可能效率更高。
苹果清楚触控的局限：苹果也明白，并非所有人都会用手指在 Safari 里浏览网页；它并不试图让触控取代鼠标或触控板。
合盖时可避免误触：如果手指放在屏幕上再合上屏幕，触控功能会被切断，以防止误操作。
前置摄像头有防抖设计：即使触碰屏幕导致机身或屏幕轻微晃动，前置摄像头也经过稳定处理，不易出现画面抖动。
不能像 iPhone 一样点屏唤醒：与 iPhone 不同，用户不能通过触摸屏幕来唤醒 Mac。
支持最多 10 点触控：多点触控最多可同时识别 10 根手指。
iPhone / iPad 应用生态被强化：具备“实时活动”的 iPhone 应用无需适配即可在灵动岛显示；Mac 开发者也可进一步适配应用。此外，iPhone 镜像功能与该触控体验高度契合，并可能很快在欧洲推出，但具体时间仍不明确。
以上图源：Nicolas Lellouche

units.text: MacBook Pro With Touch Display: 15 More Details Revealed

Apple on Wednesday unveiled new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays, and more details about them continue to be shared by tech reporters who were invited to Apple's hands-on experience in Los Angeles.

Nicolas Lellouche of the French website Numerama shared 15 details about the new MacBook Pro models in an article and a social media post. Some of this information has already surfaced, but he provided a useful summary:
Apple said the keyboard and trackpad remain the primary input methods, with touch input available as an additional option for those who want it.
Apple said there is now a generation of young creators who grew up using touchscreens, so it felt the timing was right to bring the functionality to the Mac.
Apple said music creators prefer touch over trackpads for controlling virtual instruments.
"Traffic light" controls in the top-left corner of macOS windows expand when pressed.
Items in a list become more spaced out when touched.
A swipe up from the bottom of the screen brings up the Dock.
A swipe down from the top of the screen brings up Spotlight/Siri AI.
A long press is equivalent to a right click.
Holding a window and quickly moving it left or right triggers Split View.
If you close your Mac while your finger is touching the display, touch input is temporarily deactivated to prevent accidental touches.
The camera is stabilized so it does not shake on video calls when you touch the screen.
You cannot wake the MacBook Pro by touching the screen.
Multi-touch supports up to 10 fingers at the same time. No word yet on toes (kidding).
Live Activities from iPhone apps can appear in the Dynamic Island.
There are settings that allow you to turn off touch input and the illuminated Apple logo on the MacBook Pro's lid.
The new MacBook Pro models can be pre-ordered now and launch Friday, November 6.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，苹果公司今天（10 月 31 日）发布公告，宣布将面向中国 iPhone 18 Pro 等机型用户，于 11 月 4 日开放测试，并于 12 月推出的 iOS 27.3 更新，在国内上线首批 Apple 智能（Apple Intelligence）核心功能。
IT之家援引官方新闻稿，在首批上线的 Apple 智能核心功能中，“实时翻译”已无缝整合到信息、FaceTime 通话和电话 app 中，支持用户在通话及消息场景中获得翻译体验。该功能将于 11 月 4 日起随最新 iOS 开发者 Beta 版开放测试，并于 12 月随 iOS 27.3 正式发布面向中国用户推出。
在面对面交流场景中，实时翻译还将扩展至 AirPods，用户佩戴适配耳机后，可在跨语言交流中获得实时翻译能力。苹果披露在适配耳机方面，支持 AirPods 实时翻译的有以下耳机型号（需安装最新固件并与启用 Apple 智能的 iPhone 配对）：
AirPods 5
AirPods 4（支持主动降噪）
AirPods Pro 2 及后续机型
AirPods Max 2
不过，该功能对设备有明确要求：用户需使用 iPhone 16 及后续机型、iPhone Duo、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max、iPhone Air，并将 Siri 与设备语言设置为英文或简体中文。
除实时翻译外，Apple 智能中国首批功能还包括写作工具、照片消除、智绘表情、视觉智能、优先邮件、邮件摘要及通知摘要等。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，据IT之家小伙伴反馈，苹果中国区官网今日上线了 Apple 智能的介绍页面，提示 Apple 智能的首批核心功能将于今年稍晚推出。
苹果今日宣布首批 Apple 智能功能即将在中国推出，并与阿里巴巴达成合作，在部分体验中接入千问。这是 Apple 智能自 2024 年发布以来，国行版本首次获得实质性落地进展。
这一系列 Apple 智能功能将自 11 月 4 日起随最新的 iOS 开发者 Beta 版开放测试，并将于 12 月 iOS 27.3 正式发布时面向中国用户推出。其他平台的支持将在获得必要审批后推出。
苹果中国区官网也列出了 Apple 智能兼容设备，iPhone 15 Pro 及更新机型均支持 Apple 智能。
IT之家附介绍页内容如下：
沟通
联系更紧密，干扰巧屏蔽。
Apple 智能可简化日常沟通，助你保持专注。实时翻译功能，让你跨语言交流无障碍；写作工具，令遣词造句表达贴切；还有优先通知功能，帮你尽可能减少干扰。
试试这些新功能，助你写文章、抓重点、高效沟通
开启实时翻译，就能自动翻译信息 App 中的文字，在 FaceTime 通话时显示实时翻译的字幕，以及在电话 App 中为通话提供语音翻译。如果戴着 AirPods，它甚至能把对方说的话直接翻译给你听。
在备忘录或通话中录制内容并生成摘要；邮件 App 中的电邮，也只需轻轻一点就能总结出摘要。
减少干扰这一专注模式，会突出显示可能需要及时注意的通知。首要通知会以摘要的形式叠在最上方，令大事要事一目了然。
显示优先邮件这个功能会将具有时效性的邮件置顶在收件箱，比如即日截止的邀请函或当天下午航班的值机提醒。
图像
图像功能也智能，精彩多多。
使用“消除”工具，照片中的干扰物轻轻一点就去除；叙述心中所想，定制的回忆影片随即生成；描述想要查找的内容，相应的照片和视频轻松到手；还能以好友为原型，用智绘表情大玩图像创作。
去除照片中的干扰元素，创建独特的智绘表情，定制专属的回忆影片
你可以在照片 App 中使用“消除”工具，去除画面中的干扰物。Apple 智能可识别各种背景元素，让你只需轻点一下就能去除瑕疵，在保留照片原貌的同时，令效果更加出色。
创建专属的智绘表情，表达个性十足的自己。只需输入描述或混搭喜欢的表情符号，就能打造新奇有趣的作品。还能以亲朋好友为原型创作智绘表情，有众多选项任你发挥，比如定制个发型，搭配好友的新形象。
直接在照片 App 就能定制回忆影片，创作你心目中的故事。只需输入描述，Apple 智能会找到与之匹配的照片和视频。然后根据所识别的主题，设计出故事脉络和独特情节，并将素材编排成叙事结构精巧的影片。
在照片 App 中，只需描述想要查找的内容，就能轻松找到相应的照片和视频。Apple 智能甚至能从一段视频中找到符合搜索描述的特定片段，并直接为你显示出来。
视觉智能
透过镜头，事事看得透。
你眼前的一切，都能进一步拓展了解。正在浏览的内容，瞬间提炼出摘要；五花八门的问题，立刻为你做解答，比如怎么把冰箱里的食材做成大餐。你还能在常用 App 之间顺畅搜索，比如看看朋友身上的帅气夹克哪里有卖。
生产力
办成更多事，也不费事。
Siri 随叫随到，是你日常事务的好帮手。现在叫 Siri 办事，比以往更轻松自然。焕然一新的设计，更丰富的语言理解能力，你甚至可直接打字和 Siri 沟通，怎么方便怎么来。此外，Siri 还能在需要时利用千问广博的世界知识。
好帮手再升级，看看 Siri 的好本领
Siri 以全新姿态亮相，优雅的光晕环绕屏幕四周，与整个系统的使用体验浑然一体。
如果不方便说话，你可以在 iPhone 的屏幕底部轻点两下，然后就能在系统的任意位置通过打字叫 Siri 办事。
隐私
实力过硬，也口风严密。
Apple 智能设计精密，步步防范周全，能将你的个人隐私妥妥守护好。它深植于 iPhone 的内核，并由强大的设备端处理技术驱动。当你使用 Apple 智能时，除你以外的任何人都无法访问你的数据，即使 Apple 也不例外。
千问，整合一体
现在，中国大陆用户不但能体验由 Apple 构建的模型所驱动的各种功能，还能选择通过千问来进一步扩展某些 Apple 智能功能，如 Siri、视觉智能和写作工具等。
